items.title: 印能出貨量維持高檔 Q2獲利倍增、EPS 14.04元
items.title_en: InnoTech Maintains High-End Shipment Volume, Q2 Profit Doubles, EPS NT$14.04
paras: 半導體設備廠印能科技(7734-TW)今(12)日公佈第二季財報，受惠生成式AI與HPC需求持續升溫，晶圓代工及一線封測大廠加速擴建先進封裝產線，帶動高壓真空除泡、翹曲抑制等高階製程設備出貨、進機及驗收進度加快，推升第二季歸屬母公司淨利達3.89億元，年增142.41%，每股稅後純益14.04元。
印能第二季營收9.13億元，年增48.32%，毛利率67.31%，年增1.75個百分點，營益率53.5%，年減1.25個百分點，歸屬母公司淨利達3.89億元，年增142.41%，每股稅後純益14.04元。
印能上半年營收17.9億元，年增63.09%，毛利率66.31%，年減2.03個百分點，營益率53.25%，年減1.65個百分點，歸屬母公司淨利達7.97億元，年增106.04%，每股稅後盈餘 28.72元。
印能表示，7月延續第二季強勁成長動能，單月營收達4.09億元，創下歷史新高，月增77.8%，年增62.33%，前7月累計營收21.99億元，年增62.94%。各產品線中，主要成長動能來自第二代VTS製程除泡系統。隨著CoWoS、Chiplet及大尺寸AI晶片封裝需求持續擴大，封裝面積與晶粒數量同步增加，底部填膠製程中的氣泡與空洞控制難度提高，帶動VTS設備出貨量維持高檔。
次世代面板級先進封裝方面，CoPoS於今年進入設備與材料驗證的關鍵階段，配合客戶CoPoS及面板級先進封裝驗證需求，印能將高階WSAS翹曲抑制模組與既有製程平台整合導入。WSAS可透過加壓與真空進行精準控制，可依客戶需求，在製程中即時進行翹曲控制，或於製程完成後執行整平處理，有助降低翹曲造成的製程損失，提升大尺寸封裝的量產穩定性與良率。
在次世代光電整合架構方面，隨著AI系統對高速傳輸、低延遲及低功耗的需求持續提高，晶圓代工大廠積極推動COUPE矽光子整合平台及共同封裝光學(CPO)架構。當運算晶片、光學元件與高密度互連結構整合於同一封裝，晶粒間距與凸塊間距持續縮小，傳統清潔製程更難深入封裝結構內部，使助焊劑殘留、氣泡及空洞控制成為影響接合可靠度與量產良率的重要課題。
印能第四代EvoRTS真空高壓高溫系統，將助焊劑殘留控制與空洞消除整合於單一製程平台，透過真空、高壓與熱流條件的協同控制，結合溶解、擴散及擾動機制，處理高密度封裝結構中的殘留物與微小氣泡。相較傳統分站式製程，EvoRTS有助客戶精簡助焊劑清洗、烘乾及電漿清洗等製程站點，縮短生產時間、降低設備與人力投入，並朝低殘留、低空洞及高可靠度接合目標邁進。
展望後市，隨CoWoS與Chiplet產能持續擴張，加上CoPoS設備驗證及CPO矽光子封裝逐步推進，印能將持續聚焦氣泡、翹曲、殘留與散熱等AI先進封裝良率瓶頸，可望推動WSAS及EvoRTS等高階設備接續成長。
paras_en: InnoTech Technology (7734-TW), a semiconductor equipment maker, released its Q2 earnings today (12th). Benefiting from sustained heating demand for generative AI and HPC, wafer foundries and leading front‑end test manufacturers are accelerating the expansion of advanced packaging lines, driving shipments of high‑pressure vacuum degassing and warp‑suppression equipment, speeding up machine installation and acceptance, and lifting Q2 net profit attributable to the parent company to NT$389 million, up 142.41% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of NT$14.04 after tax.

In Q2, InnoTech posted revenue of NT$913 million, up 48.32% YoY, with a gross margin of 67.31%, up 1.75 percentage points, and an operating margin of 53.5%, down 1.25 percentage points. Net profit attributable to the parent reached NT$389 million, up 142.41% YoY, and EPS was NT$14.04 after tax.

For the first half of the year, InnoTech’s revenue was NT$1.79 billion, up 63.09% YoY, gross margin fell 2.03 percentage points to 66.31%, operating margin declined 1.65 points to 53.25%, and net profit attributable to the parent rose 106.04% YoY to NT$797 million, yielding EPS of NT$28.72.

InnoTech said July continued the strong momentum of Q2, with monthly revenue hitting a record NT$409 million, up 77.8% month‑over‑month and 62.33% YoY. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months reached NT$2.199 billion, a 62.94% increase YoY. The main growth driver across product lines was the second‑generation VTS degassing system. As demand for CoWoS, chiplet and large‑size AI chip packaging expands, both package area and die count rise, making bubble and void control in bottom‑fill processes more challenging and keeping VTS equipment shipments at a premium level.

Regarding next‑generation panel‑level advanced packaging, CoPoS entered a critical equipment‑and‑material verification stage this year. To meet customers’ CoPoS and panel‑level advanced packaging verification needs, InnoTech is integrating its high‑end WSAS warp‑suppression module with existing process platforms. WSAS enables precise pressure and vacuum control, allowing real‑time warp control during processing or post‑process flattening, reducing warp‑induced losses and improving mass‑production stability and yield for large‑size packages.

In the next‑generation photonic‑integration arena, rising AI system demands for high‑speed transmission, low latency and low power are prompting major wafer foundries to push COUPE silicon‑photonics integration platforms and co‑packaged optics (CPO) architectures. When compute chips, optical components and high‑density interconnect structures are integrated in a single package, die and bump pitches shrink, making traditional cleaning processes less effective inside the package, so flux residue, bubbles and voids become critical issues affecting joint reliability and production yield.

InnoTech’s fourth‑generation EvoRTS vacuum high‑pressure high‑temperature system integrates flux‑residue control and void elimination on a single platform. By synergistically controlling vacuum, pressure and thermal flow, and combining dissolution, diffusion and disturbance mechanisms, it treats residues and micro‑bubbles in high‑density packages. Compared with conventional station‑based processes, EvoRTS helps customers streamline flux cleaning, drying and plasma‑clean stations, shortening cycle time, reducing equipment and labor costs, and moving toward low‑residue, low‑void, high‑reliability bonding.

Looking ahead, as CoWoS and chiplet capacity continues to expand, and CoPoS equipment verification and CPO silicon‑photonics packaging progress, InnoTech will keep focusing on AI‑advanced‑packaging yield bottlenecks such as bubbles, warp, residues and thermal issues, which should drive continued growth of high‑end equipment like WSAS and EvoRTS.

items.title: 信義房屋成交動能增溫  Q2營收年增逾3成 推升上半年EPS達0.45元
items.title_en: Fuyuan Realty Sees Revenue Surge in Q2, Boosting EPS to NT$0.45
paras: 受惠房市交易動能回溫，信義房屋(9940-TW)公布最新財報獲利資訊 ，2026年第二季營收30.6億元，年增33.46%，主要是仲介成交動能明顯回升，第二季稅後純益3.29億元，季增1.06倍，較去年同期轉盈，2026年上半年稅後純益4.89億元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益0.45元。
信義房屋2026年第二季營收30.6億元，毛利率28.35%，季增5.23個百分點，年增10.47個百分點，稅後純益3.29億元，季增1.06倍，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益0.45元。
信義房屋2026年上半年營收爲59.36億元，毛利率25.8%，年增6.34個百分點，2026年上半年稅後純益4.89億元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益0.45元。
信義房屋指出，2026年第二季營收與獲利雙雙大幅增長，主要得益於房市交易動能回溫及仲介事業表現亮眼。信義仲介營收年增逾3成，人均產值明顯增長，帶動合併仲介事業營收達27.48億元、年增19.98%。
此外，開發事業營收亦達3.12億元，主因大陸無錫「山水嘉庭」案於去年底推動調整後銷售計畫，持續帶動銷售動能升溫，第二季交屋認列營收金額明顯優於去年同期表現。單季合併稅後淨利來到3.32億元，其中歸屬母公司業主淨利為3.29億元，相較去年同期大幅增長。
在開發及海外事業進展方面，信義開發完銷的「嘉學」案已於7月順利舉行上樑典禮，預計於2028年交屋；台北市中山區長春段「中山逸居公辦都更案」也在今日完成簽約，而隨著新北市政府正式公告大巨蛋將落腳樹林區，也為近二年信義開發得標的土城樹林線捷運聯合開發案LG17、LG16A、B共三個開發案打了強心針。
信義房屋也將持續拓展潛在案源。大陸「山水嘉庭」案看屋來訪量持續成長，第二季單季銷售達48戶。此外，位於馬來西亞沙巴的洲際酒店主建築結構工程持續推進，開幕主樓已興建至地上20樓，預計於2027年底正式營運。
信義房屋表示，受惠於國內經濟穩健成長與AI科技產業帶動，房市交易動能逐步回升，加上新青安3.0已於8月上路，，部分政策不確定因子消除，加上年底縣市長選舉，均有可望為房市添加新柴火。
信義房屋指出，更重要的仍是業務同仁需持續落實「圓夢行動計畫」，使物件開發銷售與成交能力穩定成長，未來繼續運用AI賦能工具與直營品牌優勢強化作業動能，為買賣雙方及自己共創三張笑臉。海外市場部分，日本信義則將藉由台日資源整合，逐步加大在地化經營的腳步，推動東京港區「三田店」展店計畫，並持續擴大租賃管理與仲介服務動能。
paras_en: Fuyuan Realty (9940-TW) reported a significant surge in revenue for the second quarter of 2026, driven by a rebound in the real estate market and a notable increase in intermediary transactions. The company's revenue for the quarter reached NT$3.06 billion, a year-over-year increase of 33.46%. Net profit after tax came in at NT$329 million, a 106% quarter-over-quarter increase, and a significant improvement from the same period last year.

Fuyuan Realty's revenue for the second quarter of 2026 reached NT$3.06 billion, with a gross margin of 28.35%, a 5.23 percentage point increase from the previous quarter and a 10.47 percentage point increase from the same period last year. Net profit after tax came in at NT$329 million, a 106% quarter-over-quarter increase, and a significant improvement from the same period last year.

Fuyuan Realty's revenue for the first half of 2026 came in at NT$59.36 billion, with a gross margin of 25.8%, a 6.34 percentage point increase from the same period last year. Net profit after tax for the first half of 2026 came in at NT$489 million, a significant improvement from the same period last year.

Fuyuan Realty attributed the significant increase in revenue and net profit to the rebound in the real estate market and the strong performance of its intermediary business. The company's intermediary revenue saw a year-over-year increase of over 30%, with a significant increase in average transaction value. This drove the combined revenue of the company's intermediary business to NT$2.748 billion, a 19.98% year-over-year increase.

In addition, the company's development business saw revenue of NT$312 million, driven by the successful adjustment of the sales plan for the 'Shanshui Jiating' project in Suzhou, China, which has continued to drive sales momentum. The company's combined net profit for the quarter came in at NT$332 million, with NT$329 million attributable to shareholders, a significant increase from the same period last year.

In terms of development and overseas business, Fuyuan Realty has completed the topping-out ceremony for the 'Jiaxue' project in July, with a planned completion date of 2028. The company has also signed a contract for the 'Zhongshan Yi Ju Gong Bao Du Chuan' project in Zhongshan District, Taipei, and has received a boost from the official announcement by the New Taipei City Government to locate the 'Daguge' project in Shulin District.

Fuyuan Realty will continue to expand its potential business sources. The 'Shanshui Jiating' project in Suzhou, China, has seen a significant increase in visitor traffic, with 48 units sold in the second quarter. The company is also pushing forward with the construction of the international hotel project in Sabah, Malaysia, with the main building reaching a height of 20 floors and expected to be completed by the end of 2027.

Fuyuan Realty believes that the domestic economy will continue to grow steadily, driven by the AI technology industry, and that the real estate market will see a gradual rebound. The company also expects the launch of the 'Xin Qing An 3.0' policy in August to have a positive impact on the market, as well as the removal of some policy uncertainties and the upcoming county magistrate elections.

Fuyuan Realty emphasized that the key to its future success lies in the implementation of its 'Yuan Meng Xing Dong' plan, which aims to stabilize the growth of sales and transaction capabilities. The company will continue to leverage AI-powered tools and its direct brand advantages to enhance operational momentum and create value for both buyers and sellers. Overseas, Fuyuan Realty's Japanese subsidiary will integrate resources and gradually increase its local operations, driving the expansion of its Tokyo port area 'Sanda Shop' project and increasing its rental management and intermediary services.

items.title: 工總：核電重啟恐對產業缺電緩不濟急 籲政府應加速SMR可行性
paras: 工業總會於今(12)日舉行理監事聯席會議，由理事長潘俊榮主持會議，潘俊榮代表產業界對政府提三點政策呼籲，包括對供電穩定性之憂慮，儘管政府已開始重啟核二、核三評估審查程序，但對應半導體與AI產業的蓬勃發展，恐緩不濟急，呼籲政府可研究小型模組化反應爐(SMR)可行性，緩解產業園區或科學園區的用電壓力。
工總今舉行第13屆第10次監事會議，邀集經濟部長龔明鑫出席並發表專題演講，說明政府近期施政重點，包含強化經濟發展基礎建設、協助傳產及中小微企業等，與會理監事及顧問也就產業關注議題與龔明鑫交流，提出央行信用管制回歸市場機制、建立藥品關鍵原物料的自主生產能力、關注近期土方之亂，以及請產發署協助盤點各產業的實際勞動力需求等，皆獲龔明鑫正面回應。
潘俊榮也表達產業界，提出未來供電穩定性的憂慮，強調政府已開始重啟核二、核三的評估審查程序，但從評估到重啟至少要2-3年，對應半導體與AI產業的蓬勃發展，恐緩不濟急。期盼政府在安全無虞的前提下能加速審查流程，並研究SMR可行性，利用其高安全性、占地小及建置靈活的特性，做為基載電力，緩解產業園區或科學園區的用電壓力，
此外，潘俊榮也強調，近期AI產業雖然耀眼，但也衍生產業「K型分化」的失衡隱憂。他強調，傳產是支撐國家運作與民生穩定的堅定磐石，台灣不能只有AI好，而傳統產業被「K」到打趴在地，呼籲政府應促進產業均衡發展，在大力發展AI產業的同時，更需要關心與照顧傳統產業，讓台灣不是只有AI浪潮，也要讓百工百業都站上K字的上面，。
另針對今(2026)年年初時爆發的「土方之亂」，潘俊榮則指出，營建土方有九成是可再利用的資源，包含磚頭、混凝土等，政府應從「循環經濟」角度重新審視土方的利用價值，將其視為珍貴的國土資源而非廢棄物。
潘俊榮提出，政府可以把土方列為填海造地、港區擴建或低窪地區補強的再利用物資，透過大規模的國土重整計畫，系統性消化產業端產出的土方，在還沒找到充足的堆置地方時，應放寬暫置土地限制，補齊硬體配套缺口，推動土方的資源循環再利用，實現環保與工程進度的雙贏。

items.title: 〈鴻海法說〉Q3 AI機櫃出貨量估高雙位數季增 Vera Rubin Q4放量
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(12)日召開法說會，輪值CEO蔣集恆表示， AI機櫃出貨逐季成長的看法不變，第三季出貨量估高雙位數季增、全年維持倍數以上成長目標；輝達(NVDA-US)新一代AI平台Vera Rubin預計第四季放量出貨，將成為明年主力產品，AI伺服器市占率持續提高，朝50%目標邁進。
蔣集恆指出，Vera Rubin第三季驗證逐步完成、供應鏈及產能準備到位，第四季起後續幾季出貨量將持續提升，至於GB系列需求仍穩定、至少延續至明年；除了GPU之外，今年ASIC市占率也將大幅提升，並依客戶及專案需求，參與模組、冷卻系統、Compute及機櫃整合等關鍵環節。
財務長黃德才補充，去年AI伺服器營收約1成來自ASIC伺服器，今年上半年ASIC營收占比已略高於去年全年，隨下半年新產品陸續出貨、專案數量增加，預期ASIC出貨規模及獲利貢獻將持續提升，市占率目標則同樣維持4成以上。
通用型伺服器方面，鴻海指出，隨Agentic AI應用增加，除了AI訓練及推論需求，也將帶動更多通用型伺服器運算需求。今年通用型伺服器預期逐季成長，下半年較上半年可望有雙位數以上成長，需求能見度較3個月前更好。
鴻海引用產業預估指出，2026年通用型伺服器CPU出貨量可望年增約16%，2027年進一步提升至23%，公司身為全球主要伺服器ODM廠商，預期通用型伺服器及CPU型伺服器業務成長有機會優於整體產業平均。
高速網通產品方面，鴻海對800G以上交換機全年營收倍增目標維持不變，CPO全光交換機則按照原訂計畫於第三季量產出貨，持續強化光模組、光電整合、高階封裝、Cable Connector、高速傳輸及電源管理等關鍵零組件，公司看好，光通訊市場未來幾年將維持高速成長，市場規模可達千億美元以上。
面對新一代AI平台產品標準化趨勢，鴻海認為，公司從零組件、GPU模組、主機板、Switch Tray、Compute Tray，一路整合至AI機櫃組裝及機櫃間連線，需要長期累積工程能力及供應鏈管理經驗，標準化並不代表進入門檻降低，反而更凸顯大型供應商的規模化交付及垂直整合優勢，進入門檻只會愈來愈高。

items.title: 中國前總理朱鎔基逝世 曾在2000年總統大選前發表強硬言論
paras: 據《央視》報導，中共中央委員會宣布，中共優秀黨員，久經考驗的忠誠的共產主義戰士，傑出的無產階級革命家、政治家，黨和國家的卓越領導人，國務院前總理朱鎔基，因病醫治無效，12日（周三）11時6分在北京逝世，享耆壽98歲。
朱鎔基1928年10月生，湖南長沙人。1948年12月參加革命，1949年10月加入中國共產黨。
《央視》指出，朱鎔基擔任國務院副總理和國務院總理期間，中國正處於從計畫經濟體制向社會主義市場經濟體制轉變的關鍵時期。他主持了財稅體制改革，全面實施以公平稅負和簡化稅制為核心的重大稅制改革，實行合理劃分中央與地方事權基礎上的分稅制財政體制，進行農村稅費改革試點。
《央視》提到，他把國有企業改革作為經濟體制改革的中心環節，按照「產權清晰、權責明確、政企分開、管理科學」的要求，加快現代企業制度建設，從戰略上調整國有經濟布局和改組國有企業，強調必須千方百計促進下崗失業人員再就業，加強社會保障體系建設。
值得一提的是，在2000年台灣總統大選前夕，朱鎔基總理曾說，台灣的選舉是地方性選舉，是台灣自己的事情，大陸不想干預。「但是我們必須講清楚，不管誰上台，絕對不能搞台灣獨立，任何形式的台灣獨立都不能允許。」
朱鎔基在九屆全國人大三次會議舉行的記者會上作上述表示。
朱鎔基說：「這是我們的底線，也是代表12億5,000萬中國人民的心聲。我們解決台灣問題的一貫方針是『和平統一、一國兩制』，但是我們絕不承諾放棄使用武力。」
朱鎔基強調：「誰贊成『一個中國』的原則，我們就支持誰，我們就跟他談，什麼問題都可以談，可以讓步，讓步給中國人嘛。誰要是搞台灣獨立，你就沒有好下場。因為，你不得人心，你違背了海峽兩岸中國人的人心，你也違背了全世界華裔、華僑的人心。」

items.title: 騰訊第二季營收增長11% 但利潤未達預期 AI資本支出暴增
paras: 騰訊控股 (00700-HK) 周三 (12 日) 公布的第二季財報顯示，公司正處於轉型與重金投資的關鍵階段。雖然營收表現優於市場預期，但為了在競爭激烈的人工智慧 (AI) 領域取得領先，大幅攀升的研發與基礎設施支出顯著壓縮了獲利空間。

營收與獲利表現

根據財報數據，騰訊第二季營收達 2,047.9 億人民幣，較去年同期增長 11%，超出市場共識預期的 2,027 億人民幣。然而，股東應佔利潤 (淨利) 僅年增 0.7% 至 560 億人民幣，低於分析師普遍預估的 585 億至 618 億人民幣。若剔除一次性因素及非現金項目，Non-IFRS 經營利潤則年增 9% 至 756.4 億人民幣。
在業務部門，行銷服務 (原網路廣告) 表現最為亮眼，收入達 436 億人民幣，年增達 22%。這主要歸功於 AI 驅動的廣告推薦模型及 AIM+ 自動化平台，顯著提升了精準投放效率。
國內遊戲業務營收年增 17% 至 473 億人民幣，受惠於《王者榮耀》、《三角洲行動》及《特戰英豪》等熱門作品的貢獻，較第一季顯著回升。

資本支出與研發：全力備戰 AI 競賽 

財報中最引人注目的是其投資規模。本季資本支出 (CapEx) 暴增至 528 億人民幣，較去年同期驚人地增長 176%，季增率達 65%。這反映出騰訊正大幅增加算力採購，以建設支撐 AI 模型商業化的底層設施。同時，研發支出年增 35% 至 272.8 億人民幣。
大規模支出已對現金流造成壓力，本季自由現金流錄得負 138 億人民幣，淨現金也從 3 月底的 1,469 億人民幣驟降至 582 億人民幣。
AI 產品戰略與市場展望 騰訊董事長馬化騰指出，公司正從智慧、應用與基礎設施三個維度建構「AI 賦能的騰訊」。目前，混元大模型 (Hunyuan) 已迭代至 Hy3 正式版，其調用量較前代增長 68 倍以上。
產品端方面，AI 辦公助手  表現亮眼，6 月 PC 端訪問量突破 2,000 萬次；微信內部也正測試名為「小微」的 AI 助手。
儘管 AI 已開始轉化為實際營收，但面對阿里巴巴、字節跳動及 DeepSeek 等強勁對手，投資者的焦慮感依然存在。騰訊股價今年以來已下跌約 26%，反映市場正密切觀察這場「AI 豪賭」何時能帶來更豐厚的盈利回報。

items.title: 奇鋐上半年獲利翻倍每股大賺44.54元 下半年逐季增溫
paras: 散熱廠奇鋐(3017-TW)今(12)日召開法說會，累計今年上半年稅後純益174.83億元，年增超過1倍，每股純益44.54元。奇鋐指出，隨著GPU產品即將放量，加上ASIC水冷產品可望於第四季顯著貢獻，預期營運將「越來越好」，下半年呈現逐季增溫。
奇鋐指出，第三季成長動能來自GPU客戶加單，加上ASIC部分客戶訂單有提升。目前觀察8、9月狀況較7月更好，GPU產品將在第三季底逐步放量，ASIC水冷專案則有望於第四季有大批量的生產，並顯著貢獻營收，因此看好下半年營運將優於上半年。
產能規劃上，奇鋐表示，現階段水冷板月產能約100萬片，Rack Manifold(分歧管)月產能約7000支，約可支應3000至4000個機櫃。為因應客戶強勁需求，奇鋐針對水冷產品也規劃擴產，預計明年將擴充5成水冷相關產品產能。
資本支出方面，奇鋐今年維持150億元規模，公司為因應後續需求成長，預期明年資本支出將進一步提高。
奇鋐第二季營收491.21億元，季增0.17%，年增65.98%；毛利率32.57%，季增2.8個百分點，年增8.16個百分點；營益率27.44%，季增2.93個百分點，年增10.23個百分點；稅後純益95.67億元，季增20.86%，年增1.39倍，每股純益24.37元。
奇鋐累計今年上半年營收981.59億元，年增85.46%；毛利率31.17%，年增6.13個百分點；營益率25.97%，年增8.11個百分點；稅後純益174.83億元，年增1.42倍，每股純益44.54元。
從產品組合來看，奇鋐上半年散熱及機殼產品營收818.8億元，年增1.04倍，占整體營收83.4%，最大的營收成長動能來自散熱產品；從應用別來看，伺服器營收為649.19億元，年增1.53倍，占營收比重66.1%，帶動毛利率轉佳。

items.title: 印能出貨量維持高檔 Q2獲利倍增、EPS 14.04元
items.title_en: InnoTech Maintains High-End Shipment Volume, Q2 Profit Doubles, EPS NT$14.04
paras: 半導體設備廠印能科技(7734-TW)今(12)日公佈第二季財報，受惠生成式AI與HPC需求持續升溫，晶圓代工及一線封測大廠加速擴建先進封裝產線，帶動高壓真空除泡、翹曲抑制等高階製程設備出貨、進機及驗收進度加快，推升第二季歸屬母公司淨利達3.89億元，年增142.41%，每股稅後純益14.04元。
印能第二季營收9.13億元，年增48.32%，毛利率67.31%，年增1.75個百分點，營益率53.5%，年減1.25個百分點，歸屬母公司淨利達3.89億元，年增142.41%，每股稅後純益14.04元。
印能上半年營收17.9億元，年增63.09%，毛利率66.31%，年減2.03個百分點，營益率53.25%，年減1.65個百分點，歸屬母公司淨利達7.97億元，年增106.04%，每股稅後盈餘 28.72元。
印能表示，7月延續第二季強勁成長動能，單月營收達4.09億元，創下歷史新高，月增77.8%，年增62.33%，前7月累計營收21.99億元，年增62.94%。各產品線中，主要成長動能來自第二代VTS製程除泡系統。隨著CoWoS、Chiplet及大尺寸AI晶片封裝需求持續擴大，封裝面積與晶粒數量同步增加，底部填膠製程中的氣泡與空洞控制難度提高，帶動VTS設備出貨量維持高檔。
次世代面板級先進封裝方面，CoPoS於今年進入設備與材料驗證的關鍵階段，配合客戶CoPoS及面板級先進封裝驗證需求，印能將高階WSAS翹曲抑制模組與既有製程平台整合導入。WSAS可透過加壓與真空進行精準控制，可依客戶需求，在製程中即時進行翹曲控制，或於製程完成後執行整平處理，有助降低翹曲造成的製程損失，提升大尺寸封裝的量產穩定性與良率。
在次世代光電整合架構方面，隨著AI系統對高速傳輸、低延遲及低功耗的需求持續提高，晶圓代工大廠積極推動COUPE矽光子整合平台及共同封裝光學(CPO)架構。當運算晶片、光學元件與高密度互連結構整合於同一封裝，晶粒間距與凸塊間距持續縮小，傳統清潔製程更難深入封裝結構內部，使助焊劑殘留、氣泡及空洞控制成為影響接合可靠度與量產良率的重要課題。
印能第四代EvoRTS真空高壓高溫系統，將助焊劑殘留控制與空洞消除整合於單一製程平台，透過真空、高壓與熱流條件的協同控制，結合溶解、擴散及擾動機制，處理高密度封裝結構中的殘留物與微小氣泡。相較傳統分站式製程，EvoRTS有助客戶精簡助焊劑清洗、烘乾及電漿清洗等製程站點，縮短生產時間、降低設備與人力投入，並朝低殘留、低空洞及高可靠度接合目標邁進。
展望後市，隨CoWoS與Chiplet產能持續擴張，加上CoPoS設備驗證及CPO矽光子封裝逐步推進，印能將持續聚焦氣泡、翹曲、殘留與散熱等AI先進封裝良率瓶頸，可望推動WSAS及EvoRTS等高階設備接續成長。
paras_en: InnoTech Technology (7734-TW), a semiconductor equipment maker, released its Q2 earnings today (12th). Benefiting from sustained heating demand for generative AI and HPC, wafer foundries and leading front‑end test manufacturers are accelerating the expansion of advanced packaging lines, driving shipments of high‑pressure vacuum degassing and warp‑suppression equipment, speeding up machine installation and acceptance, and lifting Q2 net profit attributable to the parent company to NT$389 million, up 142.41% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of NT$14.04 after tax.

In Q2, InnoTech posted revenue of NT$913 million, up 48.32% YoY, with a gross margin of 67.31%, up 1.75 percentage points, and an operating margin of 53.5%, down 1.25 percentage points. Net profit attributable to the parent reached NT$389 million, up 142.41% YoY, and EPS was NT$14.04 after tax.

For the first half of the year, InnoTech’s revenue was NT$1.79 billion, up 63.09% YoY, gross margin fell 2.03 percentage points to 66.31%, operating margin declined 1.65 points to 53.25%, and net profit attributable to the parent rose 106.04% YoY to NT$797 million, yielding EPS of NT$28.72.

InnoTech said July continued the strong momentum of Q2, with monthly revenue hitting a record NT$409 million, up 77.8% month‑over‑month and 62.33% YoY. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months reached NT$2.199 billion, a 62.94% increase YoY. The main growth driver across product lines was the second‑generation VTS degassing system. As demand for CoWoS, chiplet and large‑size AI chip packaging expands, both package area and die count rise, making bubble and void control in bottom‑fill processes more challenging and keeping VTS equipment shipments at a premium level.

Regarding next‑generation panel‑level advanced packaging, CoPoS entered a critical equipment‑and‑material verification stage this year. To meet customers’ CoPoS and panel‑level advanced packaging verification needs, InnoTech is integrating its high‑end WSAS warp‑suppression module with existing process platforms. WSAS enables precise pressure and vacuum control, allowing real‑time warp control during processing or post‑process flattening, reducing warp‑induced losses and improving mass‑production stability and yield for large‑size packages.

In the next‑generation photonic‑integration arena, rising AI system demands for high‑speed transmission, low latency and low power are prompting major wafer foundries to push COUPE silicon‑photonics integration platforms and co‑packaged optics (CPO) architectures. When compute chips, optical components and high‑density interconnect structures are integrated in a single package, die and bump pitches shrink, making traditional cleaning processes less effective inside the package, so flux residue, bubbles and voids become critical issues affecting joint reliability and production yield.

InnoTech’s fourth‑generation EvoRTS vacuum high‑pressure high‑temperature system integrates flux‑residue control and void elimination on a single platform. By synergistically controlling vacuum, pressure and thermal flow, and combining dissolution, diffusion and disturbance mechanisms, it treats residues and micro‑bubbles in high‑density packages. Compared with conventional station‑based processes, EvoRTS helps customers streamline flux cleaning, drying and plasma‑clean stations, shortening cycle time, reducing equipment and labor costs, and moving toward low‑residue, low‑void, high‑reliability bonding.

Looking ahead, as CoWoS and chiplet capacity continues to expand, and CoPoS equipment verification and CPO silicon‑photonics packaging progress, InnoTech will keep focusing on AI‑advanced‑packaging yield bottlenecks such as bubbles, warp, residues and thermal issues, which should drive continued growth of high‑end equipment like WSAS and EvoRTS.

items.title: 信義房屋成交動能增溫  Q2營收年增逾3成 推升上半年EPS達0.45元
items.title_en: Fuyuan Realty Sees Revenue Surge in Q2, Boosting EPS to NT$0.45
paras: 受惠房市交易動能回溫，信義房屋(9940-TW)公布最新財報獲利資訊 ，2026年第二季營收30.6億元，年增33.46%，主要是仲介成交動能明顯回升，第二季稅後純益3.29億元，季增1.06倍，較去年同期轉盈，2026年上半年稅後純益4.89億元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益0.45元。
信義房屋2026年第二季營收30.6億元，毛利率28.35%，季增5.23個百分點，年增10.47個百分點，稅後純益3.29億元，季增1.06倍，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益0.45元。
信義房屋2026年上半年營收爲59.36億元，毛利率25.8%，年增6.34個百分點，2026年上半年稅後純益4.89億元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益0.45元。
信義房屋指出，2026年第二季營收與獲利雙雙大幅增長，主要得益於房市交易動能回溫及仲介事業表現亮眼。信義仲介營收年增逾3成，人均產值明顯增長，帶動合併仲介事業營收達27.48億元、年增19.98%。
此外，開發事業營收亦達3.12億元，主因大陸無錫「山水嘉庭」案於去年底推動調整後銷售計畫，持續帶動銷售動能升溫，第二季交屋認列營收金額明顯優於去年同期表現。單季合併稅後淨利來到3.32億元，其中歸屬母公司業主淨利為3.29億元，相較去年同期大幅增長。
在開發及海外事業進展方面，信義開發完銷的「嘉學」案已於7月順利舉行上樑典禮，預計於2028年交屋；台北市中山區長春段「中山逸居公辦都更案」也在今日完成簽約，而隨著新北市政府正式公告大巨蛋將落腳樹林區，也為近二年信義開發得標的土城樹林線捷運聯合開發案LG17、LG16A、B共三個開發案打了強心針。
信義房屋也將持續拓展潛在案源。大陸「山水嘉庭」案看屋來訪量持續成長，第二季單季銷售達48戶。此外，位於馬來西亞沙巴的洲際酒店主建築結構工程持續推進，開幕主樓已興建至地上20樓，預計於2027年底正式營運。
信義房屋表示，受惠於國內經濟穩健成長與AI科技產業帶動，房市交易動能逐步回升，加上新青安3.0已於8月上路，，部分政策不確定因子消除，加上年底縣市長選舉，均有可望為房市添加新柴火。
信義房屋指出，更重要的仍是業務同仁需持續落實「圓夢行動計畫」，使物件開發銷售與成交能力穩定成長，未來繼續運用AI賦能工具與直營品牌優勢強化作業動能，為買賣雙方及自己共創三張笑臉。海外市場部分，日本信義則將藉由台日資源整合，逐步加大在地化經營的腳步，推動東京港區「三田店」展店計畫，並持續擴大租賃管理與仲介服務動能。
paras_en: Fuyuan Realty (9940-TW) reported a significant surge in revenue for the second quarter of 2026, driven by a rebound in the real estate market and a notable increase in intermediary transactions. The company's revenue for the quarter reached NT$3.06 billion, a year-over-year increase of 33.46%. Net profit after tax came in at NT$329 million, a 106% quarter-over-quarter increase, and a significant improvement from the same period last year.

Fuyuan Realty's revenue for the second quarter of 2026 reached NT$3.06 billion, with a gross margin of 28.35%, a 5.23 percentage point increase from the previous quarter and a 10.47 percentage point increase from the same period last year. Net profit after tax came in at NT$329 million, a 106% quarter-over-quarter increase, and a significant improvement from the same period last year.

Fuyuan Realty's revenue for the first half of 2026 came in at NT$59.36 billion, with a gross margin of 25.8%, a 6.34 percentage point increase from the same period last year. Net profit after tax for the first half of 2026 came in at NT$489 million, a significant improvement from the same period last year.

Fuyuan Realty attributed the significant increase in revenue and net profit to the rebound in the real estate market and the strong performance of its intermediary business. The company's intermediary revenue saw a year-over-year increase of over 30%, with a significant increase in average transaction value. This drove the combined revenue of the company's intermediary business to NT$2.748 billion, a 19.98% year-over-year increase.

In addition, the company's development business saw revenue of NT$312 million, driven by the successful adjustment of the sales plan for the 'Shanshui Jiating' project in Suzhou, China, which has continued to drive sales momentum. The company's combined net profit for the quarter came in at NT$332 million, with NT$329 million attributable to shareholders, a significant increase from the same period last year.

In terms of development and overseas business, Fuyuan Realty has completed the topping-out ceremony for the 'Jiaxue' project in July, with a planned completion date of 2028. The company has also signed a contract for the 'Zhongshan Yi Ju Gong Bao Du Chuan' project in Zhongshan District, Taipei, and has received a boost from the official announcement by the New Taipei City Government to locate the 'Daguge' project in Shulin District.

Fuyuan Realty will continue to expand its potential business sources. The 'Shanshui Jiating' project in Suzhou, China, has seen a significant increase in visitor traffic, with 48 units sold in the second quarter. The company is also pushing forward with the construction of the international hotel project in Sabah, Malaysia, with the main building reaching a height of 20 floors and expected to be completed by the end of 2027.

Fuyuan Realty believes that the domestic economy will continue to grow steadily, driven by the AI technology industry, and that the real estate market will see a gradual rebound. The company also expects the launch of the 'Xin Qing An 3.0' policy in August to have a positive impact on the market, as well as the removal of some policy uncertainties and the upcoming county magistrate elections.

Fuyuan Realty emphasized that the key to its future success lies in the implementation of its 'Yuan Meng Xing Dong' plan, which aims to stabilize the growth of sales and transaction capabilities. The company will continue to leverage AI-powered tools and its direct brand advantages to enhance operational momentum and create value for both buyers and sellers. Overseas, Fuyuan Realty's Japanese subsidiary will integrate resources and gradually increase its local operations, driving the expansion of its Tokyo port area 'Sanda Shop' project and increasing its rental management and intermediary services.

items.title: 工總：核電重啟恐對產業缺電緩不濟急 籲政府應加速SMR可行性
paras: 工業總會於今(12)日舉行理監事聯席會議，由理事長潘俊榮主持會議，潘俊榮代表產業界對政府提三點政策呼籲，包括對供電穩定性之憂慮，儘管政府已開始重啟核二、核三評估審查程序，但對應半導體與AI產業的蓬勃發展，恐緩不濟急，呼籲政府可研究小型模組化反應爐(SMR)可行性，緩解產業園區或科學園區的用電壓力。
工總今舉行第13屆第10次監事會議，邀集經濟部長龔明鑫出席並發表專題演講，說明政府近期施政重點，包含強化經濟發展基礎建設、協助傳產及中小微企業等，與會理監事及顧問也就產業關注議題與龔明鑫交流，提出央行信用管制回歸市場機制、建立藥品關鍵原物料的自主生產能力、關注近期土方之亂，以及請產發署協助盤點各產業的實際勞動力需求等，皆獲龔明鑫正面回應。
潘俊榮也表達產業界，提出未來供電穩定性的憂慮，強調政府已開始重啟核二、核三的評估審查程序，但從評估到重啟至少要2-3年，對應半導體與AI產業的蓬勃發展，恐緩不濟急。期盼政府在安全無虞的前提下能加速審查流程，並研究SMR可行性，利用其高安全性、占地小及建置靈活的特性，做為基載電力，緩解產業園區或科學園區的用電壓力，
此外，潘俊榮也強調，近期AI產業雖然耀眼，但也衍生產業「K型分化」的失衡隱憂。他強調，傳產是支撐國家運作與民生穩定的堅定磐石，台灣不能只有AI好，而傳統產業被「K」到打趴在地，呼籲政府應促進產業均衡發展，在大力發展AI產業的同時，更需要關心與照顧傳統產業，讓台灣不是只有AI浪潮，也要讓百工百業都站上K字的上面，。
另針對今(2026)年年初時爆發的「土方之亂」，潘俊榮則指出，營建土方有九成是可再利用的資源，包含磚頭、混凝土等，政府應從「循環經濟」角度重新審視土方的利用價值，將其視為珍貴的國土資源而非廢棄物。
潘俊榮提出，政府可以把土方列為填海造地、港區擴建或低窪地區補強的再利用物資，透過大規模的國土重整計畫，系統性消化產業端產出的土方，在還沒找到充足的堆置地方時，應放寬暫置土地限制，補齊硬體配套缺口，推動土方的資源循環再利用，實現環保與工程進度的雙贏。

items.title: 〈鴻海法說〉Q3 AI機櫃出貨量估高雙位數季增 Vera Rubin Q4放量
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(12)日召開法說會，輪值CEO蔣集恆表示， AI機櫃出貨逐季成長的看法不變，第三季出貨量估高雙位數季增、全年維持倍數以上成長目標；輝達(NVDA-US)新一代AI平台Vera Rubin預計第四季放量出貨，將成為明年主力產品，AI伺服器市占率持續提高，朝50%目標邁進。
蔣集恆指出，Vera Rubin第三季驗證逐步完成、供應鏈及產能準備到位，第四季起後續幾季出貨量將持續提升，至於GB系列需求仍穩定、至少延續至明年；除了GPU之外，今年ASIC市占率也將大幅提升，並依客戶及專案需求，參與模組、冷卻系統、Compute及機櫃整合等關鍵環節。
財務長黃德才補充，去年AI伺服器營收約1成來自ASIC伺服器，今年上半年ASIC營收占比已略高於去年全年，隨下半年新產品陸續出貨、專案數量增加，預期ASIC出貨規模及獲利貢獻將持續提升，市占率目標則同樣維持4成以上。
通用型伺服器方面，鴻海指出，隨Agentic AI應用增加，除了AI訓練及推論需求，也將帶動更多通用型伺服器運算需求。今年通用型伺服器預期逐季成長，下半年較上半年可望有雙位數以上成長，需求能見度較3個月前更好。
鴻海引用產業預估指出，2026年通用型伺服器CPU出貨量可望年增約16%，2027年進一步提升至23%，公司身為全球主要伺服器ODM廠商，預期通用型伺服器及CPU型伺服器業務成長有機會優於整體產業平均。
高速網通產品方面，鴻海對800G以上交換機全年營收倍增目標維持不變，CPO全光交換機則按照原訂計畫於第三季量產出貨，持續強化光模組、光電整合、高階封裝、Cable Connector、高速傳輸及電源管理等關鍵零組件，公司看好，光通訊市場未來幾年將維持高速成長，市場規模可達千億美元以上。
面對新一代AI平台產品標準化趨勢，鴻海認為，公司從零組件、GPU模組、主機板、Switch Tray、Compute Tray，一路整合至AI機櫃組裝及機櫃間連線，需要長期累積工程能力及供應鏈管理經驗，標準化並不代表進入門檻降低，反而更凸顯大型供應商的規模化交付及垂直整合優勢，進入門檻只會愈來愈高。

items.title: 奇鋐上半年獲利翻倍每股大賺44.54元 下半年逐季增溫
paras: 散熱廠奇鋐(3017-TW)今(12)日召開法說會，累計今年上半年稅後純益174.83億元，年增超過1倍，每股純益44.54元。奇鋐指出，隨著GPU產品即將放量，加上ASIC水冷產品可望於第四季顯著貢獻，預期營運將「越來越好」，下半年呈現逐季增溫。
奇鋐指出，第三季成長動能來自GPU客戶加單，加上ASIC部分客戶訂單有提升。目前觀察8、9月狀況較7月更好，GPU產品將在第三季底逐步放量，ASIC水冷專案則有望於第四季有大批量的生產，並顯著貢獻營收，因此看好下半年營運將優於上半年。
產能規劃上，奇鋐表示，現階段水冷板月產能約100萬片，Rack Manifold(分歧管)月產能約7000支，約可支應3000至4000個機櫃。為因應客戶強勁需求，奇鋐針對水冷產品也規劃擴產，預計明年將擴充5成水冷相關產品產能。
資本支出方面，奇鋐今年維持150億元規模，公司為因應後續需求成長，預期明年資本支出將進一步提高。
奇鋐第二季營收491.21億元，季增0.17%，年增65.98%；毛利率32.57%，季增2.8個百分點，年增8.16個百分點；營益率27.44%，季增2.93個百分點，年增10.23個百分點；稅後純益95.67億元，季增20.86%，年增1.39倍，每股純益24.37元。
奇鋐累計今年上半年營收981.59億元，年增85.46%；毛利率31.17%，年增6.13個百分點；營益率25.97%，年增8.11個百分點；稅後純益174.83億元，年增1.42倍，每股純益44.54元。
從產品組合來看，奇鋐上半年散熱及機殼產品營收818.8億元，年增1.04倍，占整體營收83.4%，最大的營收成長動能來自散熱產品；從應用別來看，伺服器營收為649.19億元，年增1.53倍，占營收比重66.1%，帶動毛利率轉佳。

items.title: 〈華碩法說〉下半年記憶體漲幅趨緩 Q3 PC營收預期季增上看2成
items.title_en: Asus Forecasts Q3 PC Revenue to Rise 15-20% as Memory Price Growth Slows
paras: PC品牌華碩(2357-TW)今(12)日召開第二季法說會，共同執行長胡書賓表示，隨著下半年記憶體價格漲幅逐漸趨緩，加上高價值產品組合效益顯現，PC業務營運將逐漸走出谷底，第三季整體PC業務營收將可實現15%至20%的季成長，年成長率更可望突破20%，營運成長動能維持強勁。
胡書賓指出，雖然記憶體仍維持上漲趨勢，但相較於上半年的急漲，下半年漲勢已明顯放緩。此外，高價值產品如電競、高階機種、Copilot+ PC與商用PC在系統業務的營收占比已高達 65%，大幅增強了華碩面對零組件漲價時的營運韌性與獲利空間。共同執行長許先越補充，華碩第二季PC出貨量逆勢年增 20% ，為前五大品牌及Windows陣營中唯一維持正成長的業者。
在消費型AI PC布局方面，胡書賓表示，第二季AI PC在消費型筆電的營收占比已迅速提升至30%。共同執行長許先越說明，華碩作為NVIDIA RTX S-Park平台首發廠商，旗下的ProArt P16與P14筆電預購熱烈且已銷售一空，預計第四季擴大出貨，而採用獨家陶瓷鋁材質的Zenbook S14則預計第三季開賣，將成為下半年消費型筆電出貨量的主要成長支柱。
針對邊緣AI軟體與終端技術，共同執行長許先越表示，新機將導入ZennyCloud軟體與AI Agent功能，地端採用4B參數規模的小模型運作。商用機種更與國內廠商合作導入V-RAM虛擬化技術，可在地端運行更大規模模型並有效節省雲端Token費用。
在商用PC領域，許先越指出，受惠於導入新營運團隊與聚焦東南亞等優勢市場，第二季商用PC出貨量年增率高達58%，已連續六個季度實現50%以上的高速成長。公司透過結合軟硬體與在地服務的完整方案，相繼拿下教育、政府與大型銀行等訂單，最新搭載Intel Core Ultra處理器的ExpertBook P5也將為下半年增添成長基石。
在開放平台與電競事業方面，胡書賓表示，ROG品牌深耕電競20年，電競筆電累計出貨已達3500萬台，顯示卡累計銷量更突破1.3億張。第二季推出的掌機ROG Ally X與AR眼鏡獲得極高市場評價，持續鞏固華碩在電競生態系中的領導地位。
胡書賓說明，開放平台事業群第二季營收雖受記憶體漲價干擾而年減10%至15%，但顯示器與電競配件營收分別年增20%與50%以上。此外NUC事業部位於NVIDIA平台的NUC 14 Pro帶動營收季增30%，顯示邊緣AI工作站需求興起，隨著下半年記憶體漲幅趨緩，板卡與開放平台業務預期將重新回到成長軌道。
paras_en: Asus (2357-TW) held its second-quarter earnings conference today, where co-CEO Hu Shubin stated that as memory prices rise at a slower pace in the second half of the year, combined with the benefits of high-value product portfolios, PC business operations will gradually recover, with overall PC revenue expected to grow 15-20% in the third quarter, and annual growth rate may even exceed 20%, maintaining strong growth momentum.

Hu Shubin pointed out that although memory prices are still rising, the growth has slowed significantly compared to the first half of the year. Additionally, high-value products such as gaming, high-end models, Copilot+ PC, and commercial PCs account for 65% of system business revenue, greatly enhancing Asus' operational resilience and profit margins in the face of rising component prices. Co-CEO Hsu Hsien-yu added that Asus' PC shipments increased by 20% year-over-year in the second quarter, making it the only company among the top five brands and Windows camp to maintain positive growth.

In terms of consumer AI PC layout, Hu Shubin stated that AI PC revenue accounted for 30% of consumer laptop revenue in the second quarter. Hsu Hsien-yu explained that as the first manufacturer to launch the NVIDIA RTX S-Park platform, Asus' ProArt P16 and P14 laptops have seen strong pre-orders and are already sold out, with plans to expand shipments in the fourth quarter. The Zenbook S14, made with exclusive ceramic aluminum material, is expected to go on sale in the third quarter and will become a major driver of consumer laptop shipments in the second half of the year.

Regarding edge AI software and terminal technology, Hsu Hsien-yu stated that new machines will introduce ZennyCloud software and AI Agent functionality, using a small model with a 4B parameter scale. Commercial models will also partner with domestic manufacturers to introduce V-RAM virtualization technology, allowing for the operation of larger-scale models on terminals while effectively reducing cloud token fees.

In the commercial PC sector, Hsu Hsien-yu noted that shipments increased by 58% year-over-year in the second quarter, marking six consecutive quarters of growth above 50%. The company has secured orders from the education, government, and banking sectors by providing a comprehensive solution combining software, hardware, and local services. The latest ExpertBook P5, equipped with Intel Core Ultra processors, will also contribute to growth in the second half of the year.

In the open platform and gaming business, Hu Shubin stated that the ROG brand has been deeply involved in the gaming industry for 20 years, with cumulative shipments of gaming laptops reaching 35 million units and graphics card sales exceeding 130 million units. The ROG Ally X handheld console and AR glasses launched in the second quarter have received high market praise, further solidifying Asus' leadership in the gaming ecosystem.

Hu Shubin explained that although the open platform business group's revenue declined by 10-15% year-over-year in the second quarter due to the impact of rising memory prices, monitor and gaming accessory revenue increased by 20% and over 50%, respectively. Additionally, the NUC 14 Pro, based on the NVIDIA platform, drove a 30% quarterly revenue increase, indicating a rise in demand for edge AI workstations. As memory price growth slows in the second half of the year, the board card and open platform businesses are expected to return to a growth trajectory.

items.title: 三洋實業H1每股純益達3.47元 估下半營運優於上半年
items.title_en: Sanyo Industry H1 Net Profit Reaches NT$3.47 Per Share, Expected to Outperform H2
paras: 營造業集團三洋實業(1472-TW)今(12)日召開法人說明會，並公布最新財報獲利資訊，2026年上半年營收19.1億元，稅後純益1.82億元，與2025年同期相當，每股純益3.47元；在中型接案陸續啟動之後，法人估三洋實業下半年營運將超越去年同期及上半年表現。
三洋實業目前手中案量達260億元水準，且在包括2025年年底啟動的國家運動園區整體興設、國立高科實驗高級中等學校校舍新建工程案挹注之下，三洋實業2026下半年營運將超越去年同期及上半年表現。
三洋實業2026年第二季營收9.96億元，毛利率14.04%，季減0.63個百分點，年減1.45個百分點，單季稅後純益8887萬元，季減4.94%，年減1.73%，每股純益1.69元。
三洋實業2026年上半年營收19.1億元，毛利率14.34%，年減1.36個百分點，稅後純益1.82億元，2025年同期相當，每股純益3.47元。
三洋實業上半年營運表現主要受惠於集團在手工程執行順利，各項專案均按計畫穩定推進並按進度認列，整體工程執行效率持續提升，同期間新取得標案金額達138.74億元，接單動能穩健，為下半年及後續營運成長奠定良好基礎。
此外，三洋實業第二季營收為9.96億元，創單季歷史新高，較上季成長9％，比去年同期增加12％；單季稅後淨利8,873萬元，每股稅後純益為1.69元。以上相關財報業經會計師核閱，並已於11日經董事會承認通過。
目前三洋實業在建工程涵蓋產業園區開發、土木、公共建設、社會住宅等多元領域，包括高雄市白埔產業園區開發案、高雄捷運小港林園線RLC02標土建及設施機電工程、高雄國際機場東側立體停車場新建統包工程、國家運動園區整體興設、國立高科實驗高級中等學校校舍新建工程，以及台南市裕忠安居社會住宅新建統包工程等，將依施工進度陸續挹注未來營收。
三洋實業總經理徐正哲表示，公共建設與科技建廠為目前營造業兩大成長主軸，受惠政府持續推動重大建設，加上高科技產業投資動能穩健，營造市場需求維持暢旺。公司將持續掌握國家重大建設政策與地方發展需求，積極參與前瞻建設與高附加價值工程，擴大接單規模，持續強化營運成長動能。
paras_en: Sanyo Industry (1472-TW) held a shareholder meeting today (12th) and announced its latest financial report, with NT$191 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026, NT$182 million in net profit, and NT$3.47 per share. The company will continue to grasp the policies of national major construction projects and local development needs, actively participate in forward-looking construction and high-value-added projects, expand the scale of orders, and continue to strengthen its operational growth momentum.

items.title: 晶片股跌、它反而漲 量化資金推動「完美對沖」浮現
items.title_en: Chip Stocks Fall, Yet They Rise: Quant Funds Drive a "Perfect Hedge" Emerging
paras: AI熱潮席捲美股之際，一場反向資金輪動正悄然成形。FactSet數據顯示，近幾個月半導體與醫療保健股逐漸轉為負相關，晶片股遭遇賣壓時，資金反而湧向醫療股。隨著量化基金加速在科技與防禦型類股間換倉，醫療保健股正浮現為晶片股的「完美對沖」。
多年來，美股醫療保健與半導體類股之間的關聯並不明顯，即使偶爾同向波動，關係也相當鬆散。
然而，這項規律近幾個月明顯改變，VanEck半導體ETF(SMH-US) 與SPDR 健康護理指數 ETF(XLV-US) 開始呈現負相關，也就是晶片股下跌時，醫療保健股往往獲得資金青睞。
高盛美國醫療保健股票研究主管Asad Haider指出，如今左右醫療保健類股交易邏輯的最大焦點，其實來自產業之外，這種情況對專注公司基本面的投資人而言相當棘手。
背後推手之一正是量化資金。演算法會持續監測市場訊號，一旦動能指標轉向，量化基金可能迅速撤離科技股等交易過度擁擠的領域，轉進先前遭市場冷落的醫療保健股。近期換倉速度加劇，也反映投資人對AI熱潮能否持續的戒心正在升高。
醫療股成晶片股「完美對沖」
這種資金輪動在近期行情尤其明顯。6月下旬至7月下旬市場劇烈震盪期間，隨著投資人對AI多頭行情能否延續的疑慮升高，醫療保健類股漲幅一度跑贏半導體超過30個百分點。
這與過去四年的情況形成強烈反差。這段期間，SMH累計漲幅曾超過300%，XLV則僅上漲約25%。如今兩者表現迅速拉開，也凸顯市場開始將醫療保健股視為對沖晶片股風險的工具。
估值差距同樣提供支撐。約十年前，在AI概念尚未爆發時，晶片與醫療保健類股的遠期本益比都約在15至16倍；如今FactSet數據顯示，SMH近幾個月遠期本益比維持在22至30倍高檔，XLV則約為18倍。
AI需求確實讓半導體產業擁有更快的成長速度，但市場目前最大的疑問也正是，這樣的高成長究竟還能維持多久。
防禦屬性撐起避險價值
醫療保健股之所以能扮演避險角色，關鍵在於產業屬性與半導體截然不同。半導體具有高度週期性，醫療保健則具備非週期性的防禦特徵。
不論總體經濟如何變化，或AI基礎建設進展如何，患者對藥物與醫療服務仍存在剛性需求，因此相關企業的業績與現金流在經濟放緩期間通常相對穩定。
此外，醫療產業先前面臨的政治壓力也逐漸降溫。市場對川普政府大幅削減藥價的疑慮下降，美國聯邦Medicare健保計畫公布的支付標準也高於原先預期；禮來(LLY-US) 、嬌生(JNJ-US) 、聯合健康集團(UNH-US) 與艾伯維(ABBV-US) 等大型企業，則持續展現相對穩健且可預測的獲利成長。
AI行情決定對沖交易能走多遠
展望後市，醫療保健類股未來一、兩年的實際表現，很大程度仍取決於AI交易熱潮將走到哪個階段。
2022年美股熊市便提供類似案例，當時通膨高漲、聯準會激進升息，高估值科技股重挫，醫療保健類股期間跑贏半導體超過30個百分點。
不過，資金以宏觀邏輯買進整個醫療保健產業，也可能掩蓋個別企業基本面的差異。
百時美施貴寶與強生過去12個月股價都上漲逾40%，但兩者基本面並不相同：強生維持穩定獲利成長，百時美施貴寶則面臨核心專利到期帶來的業績下滑壓力。
Haider因此強調，無論AI交易接下來如何發展，較穩健的策略仍是聚焦能夠實現營收內生成長的企業，而非單純買進看似便宜的股票。
隨著醫療保健產業基本面逐步企穩，本身的防禦與成長特性已提供配置理由；若AI主線交易進一步瓦解，其作為晶片股對沖工具的吸引力，可能更加凸顯。
paras_en: As the AI frenzy sweeps U.S. equities, a reverse capital rotation is quietly taking shape. FactSet data shows that in recent months semiconductor and healthcare stocks have become increasingly negatively correlated; when chip stocks face selling pressure, capital instead flows into healthcare stocks. As quantitative funds accelerate the reallocation between technology and defensive sectors, healthcare stocks are emerging as the "perfect hedge" for chip stocks.
For many years, the relationship between U.S. healthcare and semiconductor stocks has been unclear, and even when they moved in the same direction, the link was quite loose.

However, this pattern has changed markedly in recent months, with the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH-US) and the SPDR Health Care Sector ETF (XLV-US) beginning to show a negative correlation—meaning that when chip stocks fall, healthcare stocks often attract capital.

Asad Haider, head of U.S. healthcare equity research at Goldman Sachs, noted that the biggest driver of current trading logic for healthcare stocks actually comes from outside the industry, a situation that is especially tricky for investors focused on company fundamentals.

One of the forces behind this is quantitative capital. Algorithms continuously monitor market signals, and once momentum indicators reverse, quantitative funds may quickly exit crowded areas such as tech stocks and move into healthcare stocks that have been neglected by the market. The recent acceleration in reallocation also reflects growing investor caution about whether the AI boom can be sustained.
Healthcare stocks as the "perfect hedge" for chip stocks

This capital rotation has been especially evident in recent market action. During the volatile period from late June to late July, as investors grew more doubtful about the continuation of the AI bull market, healthcare stocks surged, at times outperforming semiconductors by more than 30 percentage points.

That contrasts sharply with the past four years. In that period, SMH posted a cumulative gain of over 300%, while XLV rose only about 25%. The widening gap now highlights the market’s shift toward viewing healthcare stocks as a tool to hedge chip‑stock risk.

Valuation differences also provide support. About a decade ago, before the AI concept exploded, forward price‑to‑earnings ratios for both chips and healthcare were roughly 15‑16 times; today FactSet data shows SMH’s forward P/E has been stuck in the high 22‑30 range, while XLV’s is around 18 times.
AI demand indeed gives the semiconductor industry a faster growth trajectory, but the market’s biggest question now is how long such high growth can be maintained.
Defensive attributes underpin hedging value

Healthcare stocks can play a defensive role because the sector’s fundamentals are fundamentally different from semiconductors. Semiconductors are highly cyclical, whereas healthcare has non‑cyclical, defensive characteristics.

Regardless of macro‑economic shifts or the progress of AI infrastructure, patients continue to have rigid demand for drugs and medical services, so the earnings and cash flow of related companies tend to remain relatively stable during economic slowdowns.

In addition, the political pressures that previously weighed on the healthcare industry are easing. Concerns about the Trump administration’s large drug‑price cuts have receded, and the U.S. Medicare payment standards have been announced higher than expected. Large firms such as Eli Lilly (LLY-US), Johnson & Johnson (JNJ-US), UnitedHealth Group (UNH-US) and AbbVie (ABBV-US) continue to show relatively steady and predictable profit growth.
How far hedging trades can go depends on the AI market
Looking ahead, the actual performance of healthcare stocks over the next one to two years will largely depend on which stage the AI trading boom reaches.

The 2022 U.S. bear market provides a similar case: high inflation and aggressive Fed rate hikes caused heavily‑valued tech stocks to plunge, while healthcare stocks outperformed semiconductors by more than 30 percentage points during that period.
However, buying the entire healthcare sector on a macro basis can also mask differences in individual company fundamentals.

Both Bristol‑Myers Squibb and Johnson & Johnson have seen their shares rise over 40% in the past 12 months, but their fundamentals differ: Johnson & Johnson maintains stable earnings growth, whereas Bristol‑Myers faces earnings pressure from core patent expirations.

Haider therefore emphasizes that, regardless of how AI trading evolves, a more prudent strategy remains to focus on companies that can generate internal revenue growth rather than simply buying stocks that appear cheap.

As the healthcare industry’s fundamentals gradually stabilize, its defensive and growth traits already provide a rationale for allocation; if the AI trade further unravels, its appeal as a hedge for chip stocks could become even more pronounced.

items.title: 川普政府：TikTok業務重組後不再被視為國安威脅 已正式解禁
items.title_en: Trump Administration: TikTok No Longer Deemed a National Security Threat After Business Restructuring, Officially Unbanned
paras: 根據白宮管理和預算辦公室(OMB)本周發布的最新備忘錄，美國政府已正式撤銷2023年制定的聯邦設備TikTok禁令。這項重大轉變源於美國司法部上個月的一項法律意見，認為在完成業務重組後，TikTok已不再符合2022年法律所定義的「受管制應用程式」。
此次解禁的核心在於TikTok美國業務的深度重組。今年1月，TikTok USDS合資公司正式運作，股權結構發生劇烈變動：甲骨文(ORCL-US)、銀湖資本(Silver Lake)及阿聯MGX各持股15%，母公司字節跳動的持股比例降至19.9%，新公司的董事會成員多數為美國人。
在技術層面上，TikTok為消除國安疑慮，已將美國用戶數據全數遷往甲骨文的美國本地伺服器，並針對美國用戶重新訓練推薦算法。
司法部指出，目前的TikTok運作獨立於字節跳動，並已修訂其內容推薦機制與網路安全程序，足以隔絕聯邦政府資訊遭竊取的風險。
川普對TikTok的態度轉變也備受矚目。2020年曾強硬要求禁用的他，在2024年競選期間卻頻繁利用該平台與選民互動，並將勝選部分歸功於此。川普不僅稱讚TikTok，還對中國領導人習近平協助推動出售交易表達謝意。
TikTok在美國擁有超過2億用戶，已成為政治人物接觸年輕選民的核心陣地。雖然聯邦禁令已撤銷，但司法部強調各部門仍有裁量權，並非強制要求所有聯邦設備安裝
paras_en: According to a new memorandum released this week by the White House Office of Management and Budget (OMB), the U.S. government has formally lifted the federal‑device TikTok ban that was enacted in 2023. The shift follows a legal opinion from the Department of Justice last month that concluded TikTok no longer meets the definition of a “controlled application” under the 2022 law after completing its business restructuring.

The core of the unbanning is the deep restructuring of TikTok’s U.S. operations. In January, the TikTok USDS joint venture began operating, and its ownership structure changed dramatically: Oracle (ORCL‑US), Silver Lake and UAE‑based MGX each hold 15%, while the parent company ByteDance’s stake fell to 19.9%. Most members of the new company’s board are Americans.
On the technical side, TikTok has moved all U.S. user data to Oracle’s U.S.‑based servers and has retrained its recommendation algorithm for U.S. users to eliminate national‑security concerns.

The Justice Department notes that TikTok now operates independently of ByteDance and has revised its content recommendation mechanisms and cybersecurity procedures enough to isolate the risk of federal government information being stolen.

Trump’s attitude toward TikTok has also shifted dramatically. After forcefully demanding a ban in 2020, he frequently used the platform to interact with voters during his 2024 campaign and credited part of his victory to it. Trump not only praised TikTok but also thanked Chinese leader Xi Jinping for helping facilitate the sale transaction.

TikTok has over 200 million users in the United States and has become a key arena for politicians to reach young voters. Although the federal ban has been lifted, the Justice Department emphasizes that individual agencies still retain discretion and are not required to install the app on all federal devices.

items.title: 記憶體長約擴散至二三線！長鑫拒蘋果降價、SanDisk最長鎖5年
items.title_en: Memory Long-Term Contracts Spread to Tier‑2 and Tier‑3 Suppliers! ChangXin Rejects Apple Price Cuts, SanDisk Locks in Up to 5 Years
paras: 全球記憶體晶片供需失衡持續加劇，長期供應協議（LTA）正從三星電子、SK 海力士與美光等主要記憶體大廠，進一步擴散至 SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 及中國長鑫儲存。
隨著客戶爭相提前鎖定產能，過去由買方主導的議價模式逐漸翻轉，供應商定價權明顯提升，長約期限、預付款與違約保障也同步強化，重塑記憶體產業的供應與定價邏輯。
記憶體供應緊張之下，長期供應協議已不再只是三星電子 (KR005930) 、SK 海力士 (000660KS) 與美光科技 (MU-US) 等一線大廠的現象，SanDisk 與長鑫儲存也加入這波長約浪潮，顯示客戶鎖定供應的需求正在向更多記憶體供應商擴散。
其中，長鑫儲存近期的議價能力尤其受到關注。為確保產品供應穩定，蘋果已測試並採用長鑫儲存產品，接受其「現成晶片」供貨模式。不過，當蘋果試圖進一步壓低 DRAM 採購價格時，卻遭到長鑫儲存拒絕。
韓國媒體《Digital Daily》報導，長鑫儲存堅持報價不得低於三星電子與 SK 海力士，甚至要求更高價格。背後原因在於華為、小米等中國本土企業已透過長期合約提前鎖定長鑫儲存產能，使其不必為爭取蘋果訂單而接受更苛刻的價格條件。
這也反映當前記憶體市場供需關係的變化。當產能成為稀缺資源，即使是採購規模龐大的客戶，也不再能像過去一樣單方面主導價格談判。
長約期限從 1 年拉長至 5 年
更明顯的結構性改變，則出現在合約期限。過去記憶體產業標準合約週期通常只有一年，買方掌握較大主動權，在供應寬鬆時壓低價格，供應吃緊時則提高採購量、鎖定供應，但如今這套模式正在被打破。
根據高盛針對三星、SK 海力士、美光與 SanDisk 四家廠商的長約條款比較，目前各廠合約期限普遍以 5 年為主，部分客戶選擇 3 年期，即使最短的合約期限，也已達到過去一年期產業慣例的 3 倍。
三星近期在財報電話會上更明確表示，公司 LTA 以 5 年為基礎期限，並設有逐年滾動續約機制，以確保合約持續有效。
三星聯席執行長 Kim Yong-hyun 先前指出，隨著 AI 投資擴張帶來供需不確定性，公司正從傳統短期協議轉向 3 至 5 年的多年期合約。
SK 海力士也指出，客戶對 LTA 的需求持續增加。目前 SK 海力士的前十大 LTA 客戶及關鍵客戶，合約期間大多為 5 年。
美光則已與 16 家策略客戶簽約，多數合約同樣為期 5 年，車用客戶則為 3 年。至於 SanDisk，8 家 LTA 客戶的加權平均合約期已超過 4 年，最長達五年。
4 家廠商同步將長約期限拉長，意味買方未來即使面臨需求或供需環境變化，調整採購策略的空間也將受到進一步壓縮。
預付款讓長約從承諾變成真金白銀
除了合約期限延長，本輪 LTA 另一項關鍵變化，是預付款機制全面落地。
過去記憶體長約的執行力相對有限，即使買方已經簽約，仍可能削減採購量、延後交貨甚至違約，而不必承擔太大的實質代價。
但這一輪供應商開始要求客戶提前投入大筆資金，使長期採購承諾真正轉化為具有財務約束力的合約。
從目前揭露的條款來看，美光預計將收到約 220 億美元現金定金及相關財務承諾；SanDisk 則已揭露超過 110 億美元的財務擔保，以及 165 億美元的客戶違約保護。
三星也表示，合約中包含大額預付款，目前已收取約四分之一。
對雲端服務商而言，若要確保 2028 年前取得足夠的 HBM 與 DRAM 供應，可能必須提前將數十億美元資金存入供應商帳上。這些資金一方面鎖定未來供貨，另一方面也將買方綁定在合約之中，大幅提高違約成本。
高盛因此將預付款機制視為「本輪 LTA 週期與歷輪最顯著的區別特徵」。
從 SanDisk 到長鑫儲存，長期供應協議向更多廠商擴散，加上合約期限拉長與預付款制度成形，顯示記憶體產業的供需權力結構正在改變，供應商的定價權與議價能力也隨之提升。
paras_en: Global memory chip supply‑demand imbalance continues to worsen, and long‑term supply agreements (LTAs) are expanding beyond major memory makers Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron to include SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) and China’s ChangXin Storage.

As customers race to lock in capacity early, the buyer‑driven bargaining model is gradually reversing, giving suppliers clear pricing power. LTA terms, upfront payments and breach protections are also being strengthened, reshaping the memory industry’s supply and pricing logic.

With memory supply tight, LTAs are no longer a phenomenon limited to first‑tier giants Samsung Electronics (KR005930), SK Hynix (000660KS) and Micron Technology (MU‑US). SanDisk and ChangXin Storage have joined this wave, showing that customer‑driven supply locking is spreading to more memory providers.

ChangXin Storage’s recent bargaining strength has drawn particular attention. To ensure stable product supply, Apple has tested and adopted ChangXin’s products, accepting its “ready‑die” supply model. However, when Apple tried to push DRAM purchase prices lower, ChangXin refused.

Korean media outlet Digital Daily reported that ChangXin insists its pricing not fall below Samsung and SK Hynix, even demanding higher prices. The reason is that Chinese firms such as Huawei and Xiaomi have already locked ChangXin capacity through long‑term contracts, allowing it to avoid conceding to harsher terms for Apple orders.

This also reflects a shift in the current memory market’s supply‑demand dynamics. When capacity becomes scarce, even large‑scale buyers can no longer unilaterally dominate price negotiations as they once did.
LTA durations have been stretched from 1 year to 5 years

A more obvious structural change appears in contract length. Historically, the memory industry’s standard contract cycle was typically one year, giving buyers the upper hand: they could push prices down when supply was ample and increase purchases or lock supply when it was tight. That model is now being broken.

According to Goldman Sachs’ comparison of LTA terms for Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron and SanDisk, most contracts now run for five years, with some customers opting for three‑year terms—still three times the previous industry norm of one‑year contracts.
Samsung recently clarified in its earnings call that its LTAs are based on a five‑year term with a rolling annual renewal mechanism to keep contracts continuously effective.

Samsung co‑CEO Kim Yong‑hyun previously noted that as AI investment expansion creates supply‑demand uncertainty, the company is shifting from traditional short‑term agreements to multi‑year contracts of three to five years.
SK Hynix also said demand for LTAs from customers continues to rise. Its top ten LTA customers and key accounts mostly have five‑year contract periods.

Micron has signed LTAs with 16 strategic customers, most for five years, while automotive customers have three‑year terms. For SanDisk, the weighted‑average LTA term across eight customers exceeds four years, with the longest reaching five years.
All four manufacturers extending LTA durations means that even if buyers face demand or market‑condition changes, their ability to adjust procurement strategies will be further compressed.
Up‑front payments turn LTAs from commitments into cash
Beyond longer terms, a key change in this round of LTAs is the full implementation of upfront‑payment mechanisms.

Historically, the enforceability of long‑term memory contracts was limited; even after signing, buyers could cut purchase volumes, delay deliveries or breach contracts without bearing substantial costs.
Now suppliers are demanding large upfront cash injections, converting long‑term purchase commitments into financially binding contracts.

Based on disclosed terms, Micron expects to receive about $22 billion in cash deposits and related financial commitments; SanDisk has disclosed over $11 billion in financial guarantees and $16.5 billion in customer breach protection.
Samsung also said its contracts include sizable upfront payments, having already collected roughly one‑quarter of the agreed amount.

For cloud service providers, securing enough HBM and DRAM supply before 2028 may require depositing tens of billions of dollars with suppliers in advance. This locks future supply while binding buyers to the contracts, dramatically raising breach costs.
Goldman Sachs therefore views the upfront‑payment mechanism as “the most distinctive feature of this LTA cycle compared with previous rounds.”

From SanDisk to ChangXin Storage, LTAs are spreading to more manufacturers. Combined with longer contract terms and the emergence of upfront‑payment structures, the memory industry’s supply‑demand power balance is shifting, enhancing suppliers’ pricing power and bargaining strength.

items.title: 仍有望漲350%！大摩預測SpaceX股價衝擊600美元 但前提條件極為苛刻
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Predicts SpaceX Stock Price to Reach $600, But with Extremely Challenging Assumptions
paras: 摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)分析師Adam Jonas週二(11日)重申對SpaceX股票「增持」評等，基準目標價300美元，同時拋出震動市場的「牛市情景」。若一切順利，SpaceX可衝上600美元，對應估值高達8兆美元，將超越當前全球任何上市公司。SpaceX週二收在133.29美元，較6月IPO發行價135美元略低，市值約1.75兆美元。
要從133跳到600， Jonas關鍵假設極為苛刻：Starship完全可重複用火箭須高頻高效飛行，把軌道AI資料中心部署成本砍半；Starlink不能只做家用寬頻，要到2040年接入數億甚至數十億台AI機器人，每用戶平均收入(ARPU)拉到35美元。
32位受訪分析師平均預期SpaceX股價約227美元，區間從輝立證券75美元到雷蒙德詹姆斯800美元，晨星更冷靜預估：核心發射與Starlink業務價值僅約每股40美元，其餘估值幾乎全押在AI/軌道資料中心敘事上，即便自家「登月情景」154美元也只給7%機率。
質疑聲浪則聚焦兩點：一，Jonas在7月24日報告中曾自承，若股價僅100美元，市場等於完全沒給AI業務定價，如此600美元的大部分上行，來自目前仍大幅虧損、客戶可提前90天無懲罰退租的AI合約；二，SpaceX第二季資本支出184億美元、其中AI相關約158億，上半年燒錢285億美元，技術尚未完全驗證就把估值鎖在「一切順利」假設上，屬高風險貼現。
這場估值8兆美元設想的本質是把「火箭複用+星鏈機器人網路+軌道AI算力」三條尚未規模化的曲線疊加折現，基準300美元或許反映市場願意為執行力付溢價，但600美元更像一張寫給2040年的選擇權，而非當下可兌付的價格錨。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Jonas reaffirmed his "buy" rating for SpaceX stock on Tuesday, setting a base price target of $300. He also presented a market-shaking "bull case" scenario. If everything goes smoothly, SpaceX could reach $600, corresponding to a valuation of $800 billion, surpassing any listed company globally. SpaceX closed at $133.29 on Tuesday, slightly lower than its IPO price of $135 in June, with a market value of approximately $175 billion.

To jump from $133 to $600, Jonas made extremely challenging assumptions: Starship must be able to launch repeatedly at a high frequency and efficiency, and the cost of deploying an orbital AI data center must be cut in half. Additionally, Starlink must not only provide home broadband but also connect billions or even tens of billions of AI robots by 2040, with an average revenue per user (ARPU) of $35.

Thirty-two analysts surveyed by Bloomberg expect SpaceX's stock price to be around $227, with a range from $75 by Credit Suisse to $800 by Raymond James. Morningstar is more conservative, estimating that the core launch and Starlink business value is around $40 per share, with the rest of the valuation largely dependent on the AI/Orbital Data Center narrative, even its "moonshot" scenario of $154 only gives a 7% probability.

Critics focus on two points: one, Jonas himself admitted in his July 24 report that if the stock price is only $100, the market is essentially giving no value to the AI business. The majority of the potential upside to $600 comes from AI contracts that are currently heavily loss-making and allow customers to cancel their subscriptions 90 days in advance without penalty. Two, SpaceX's capital expenditure in the second quarter was $18.4 billion, with approximately $15.8 billion related to AI, and the company burned $28.5 billion in the first half of the year, with the technology still unproven, it's a high-risk assumption to lock in valuation based on "everything going smoothly".

The $800 billion valuation scenario is essentially a combination of three unproven curves: rocket reuse, Starlink robot network, and orbital AI computing power. The base price of $300 may reflect the market's willingness to pay a premium for execution, but $600 is more like a call option for 2040, rather than a current price anchor that can be paid out.

items.title: 川普媒體戰略轉向：削減多元業務 每月10萬美元賣「總統訊息」優先存取權
items.title_en: Trump Media Shifts Strategy: Cutting Diversified Businesses to Focus on Truth Social
paras: 川普媒體與科技集團 (Trump Media & Technology Group)(TMTG) 宣布重大的戰略調整。這家由美國總統川普創立的公司，在嘗試橫跨加密貨幣、線上博弈及核融合等多個領域後，決定放棄大部分多元化業務，重新聚焦於其社群平台 Truth Social。
根據周一 (10 日) 公布的財報，川普媒體在截至 6 月 30 日的第二季表現慘淡，虧損高達 2.38 億美元，是去年同期虧損額的十倍以上。雖然營收增長至 170 萬美元，但仍無法抵消龐大的支出。
這筆巨額虧損中很大一部分，來自於公司持有的比特幣等加密資產價值縮水所帶來的帳面損失。新任執行長麥格恩 (Kevin McGurn) 坦言，公司將進行「紀律性的選擇」，裁撤與媒體核心業務無關的投資。
為了提振營收，公司推出了一項名為「Truth API」的新服務，向華爾街高頻交易公司等機構出售「搶先獲取」川普貼文的權限。由於川普經常在該平台上發布影響市場的重大政策 (如關稅或外交局勢)，這些數據對交易者而言極具價值。
目前已有超過 10 家公司簽約，每家每月支付 6 萬至 10 萬美元。麥格恩預計，僅這項業務每年就能為公司帶來 700 萬至 1200 萬美元的收入，這相當於該公司去年全年營收的兩到三倍。除了交易員，公司還計畫將此服務擴展至新聞機構及大語言模型開發商。
然而，這項業務引發了嚴重的道德與法律質疑。民主黨人與政府監管機構批評這等同於「變相出售白宮存取權」，讓特定投資者利用總統的公開聲明謀取暴利。參議員華倫 (Elizabeth Warren) 等人已表態，若民主黨在中期選舉後取得國會主導權，將對此展開正式調查。
paras_en: Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG) announced a major strategic shift. The company, founded by former US President Donald Trump, has decided to abandon most of its diversified businesses and focus on its social media platform Truth Social after trying to expand into various areas such as cryptocurrencies, online gaming, and nuclear fusion.

According to the quarterly report released on Monday (10th), Trump Media's second-quarter performance was dismal, with a net loss of $238 million, more than ten times the loss of the same period last year. Although revenue grew to $1.7 million, it was not enough to offset the massive expenses.

A significant portion of this massive loss came from the decline in value of the company's holdings in cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, resulting in a book loss. New CEO Kevin McGurn said the company would make 'disciplined choices' and cut investments unrelated to its core media business.

To boost revenue, the company introduced a new service called 'Truth API,' which sells 'first access' to Trump's posts to institutions such as high-frequency trading companies on Wall Street. Since Trump frequently posts significant policy updates (such as tariffs or diplomatic situations) on the platform, this data is highly valuable to traders.

More than 10 companies have already signed up, each paying $600,000 to $1 million per month. McGurn expects this business alone to generate $7 million to $12 million in revenue per year, which is equivalent to two to three times the company's revenue last year. In addition to traders, the company plans to expand this service to news organizations and large language model developers.

However, this business has raised serious moral and legal concerns. Democrats and government regulatory agencies have criticized it as 'de facto selling access to the White House,' allowing specific investors to profit from Trump's public statements. Senators such as Elizabeth Warren have already stated that if the Democrats gain control of Congress after the midterm elections, they will launch a formal investigation.

items.title: 輝達AI融資案「撕裂市場」 資管巨頭暴漲、科技股卻連跌2天
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 攜手華爾街六大金融機構，規劃規模達 5,000 億美元的 AI 基礎建設融資平台，在資本市場掀起截然不同的反應。合作消息公布後，另類資產管理巨頭股價全面大漲，反觀大型科技股連續第二個交易日承壓，凸顯投資人對這套 AI 融資模式存在明顯分歧：它究竟是支撐 AI 基建擴張的金融創新，還是意味部分 AI 需求已需要靠融資才能持續擴張？
輝達執行長黃仁勳周一 (10 日) 與高盛(GS-US) 、貝萊德 (BLK-US) 、黑石 (BX-US) 、KKR(KKR-US) 、阿波羅 (APO-US) 及博楓資產管理 (BAM-US) 高層共同亮相，宣布六家金融機構簽署合作備忘錄，將各自建立獨立的算力融資平台，透過第三方資本市場為 AI 基礎建設募集資金，目標規模達 5,000 億美元，甚至可能進一步擴大。
黃仁勳將這項計畫形容為一項「大構想」，核心概念是重新定義 AI 算力的金融屬性。他指出，AI 系統不同於個人電腦或手機，而是能夠創造營收的資產，具有生產力、長壽命、可替代性與靈活性。
KKR 數位基礎設施主管 Waldemar Szlezak 則表示，可以將 AI 算力視為一種收入流，再進一步證券化或切割風險，提供不同類型的投資人參與。高盛執行長 David Solomon 也認為，針對 AI 基礎設施進行資產抵押融資並不令人意外，因為背後存在具有實際價值的實體資產。
按照目前規劃，六家金融機構將各自獨立進行貸款決策，輝達則負責媒合客戶與融資夥伴，並可選擇為每筆貸款承擔不超過 25% 的擔保曝險。
黃仁勳隨後在社群平台 X 澄清，相關支援是基於資產殘值，目的在補充、而非取代獨立承銷。
資管巨頭狂歡　融資平台成新金礦
市場首先用股價為這項計畫投下贊成票的，是參與其中的另類資產管理業者。KKR 周二（11 日）大漲 6.88%，阿波羅全球管理 (APO-US) 勁揚 6.26%，博楓資產管理 (BAM-US) 上漲 4.77%，黑石 (BX-US) 漲 3.89%，貝萊德 (BLK-US) 也上漲 1.54%。
市場將龐大的 AI 融資管道視為私募信貸與另類投資業務的直接利多，因為資金規模擴張意味著未來管理費收入具有長期成長空間。
AI 基建相關業者也同步受惠，Nebius(NBIS-US) 上漲 4.95%、Riot Platforms (RIOT-US) 漲 4.33%、Hut(HUT-US) 8 漲 3.64%、Iris(IREN-US) 漲 2.61%。
GPU 雲端運算服務商 CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 常規交易時段上漲 2.42%，盤後一度飆漲逾 16%。
CoreWeave 正是這項融資模式潛在受益最直接的新興雲端業者之一，其具備實際算力需求，卻缺乏超大規模雲端服務商的資產負債表支撐，正符合融資平台鎖定的客戶特徵。
科技股連跌 市場有兩種解讀
但與資管業者及 AI 基建鏈的強勢形成鮮明對比，大型科技股卻連續第二個交易日走弱。
Google(GOOGL-US) 周二收跌 3.84%，創近六個月最大單日跌幅，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 2.09%、蘋果 (AAPL-US) 跌 1.09%、博通 (AVGO-US) 跌 1.5%、微軟 (MSFT-US) 跌 0.44%，輝達 (NVDA-US) 本身則幾乎收平，微跌 0.02%；美股三大指數連續第二日收黑，那斯達克指數下跌 0.6%。
這種走勢反映市場對 5,000 億美元融資計畫的另一種解讀。如果 AI 算力需求確實如此強勁，擁有雄厚資產負債表的超大規模雲端業者理應直接受惠。
如今輝達必須親自協助客戶建立融資管道，反而使部分投資人擔心，潛在需求方的財務能力是否已開始承受壓力。
信用市場同樣尚未完全消化疑慮。輝達五年期信用違約交換（CDS）今年以來已飆升約 90%，周二雖在黃仁勳澄清後收窄 5 個基點至 72.11 個基點，但仍處於歷史高檔附近，「循環融資」的爭議並未因此消失。
「循環融資」最大懸念：GPU 殘值
這套融資模式背後的產業邏輯，是 AI 發展瓶頸正由晶片與電力逐漸延伸至資本。
除了超大規模雲端業者之外，AI 實驗室、新興雲端運算公司與主權 AI 計畫同樣存在龐大算力需求，卻缺少 Google、微軟等科技巨頭的資產負債表支撐。
一座 1 吉瓦級 AI 資料中心造價約 500 億美元，而 OpenAI 至今仍沒有投資等級信用評等。
貝萊德執行長 Larry Fink 將這套模式與抵押貸款證券化市場早期發展相比，認為這可能是金融工程的下一個方向。
阿波羅全球管理總裁 Jim Zelter 則坦言，過程中「會有過度，也會有回調」，但參與者眾多有助分散集中度風險。
然而，市場最大的疑問仍未解決：作為抵押品的 GPU，長期殘值究竟有多少？輝達晶片更新週期已從兩年一代加快至一年一代，新一代產品效能躍升，也可能持續削弱上一代晶片的市場價值。
因此，整套融資模型的重要基礎——GPU 殘值——至今仍未經歷完整產業週期的考驗。
此外，目前公布的僅是合作備忘錄，沒有合約約束力，具體借款方、利率、設施選址與啟動時間均未揭露。
博楓執行長 Bruce Flatt 指出，黃仁勳之所以主導建立這些融資架構，是因為全球存在「數百萬億美元」的資金。
龐大資本池或許正是這項 5,000 億美元「大構想」最有力的支撐，但在 GPU 殘值與實際融資細節仍待驗證之際，也成為市場分歧最大的未知數。

items.title: 美7月CPI公布在即！高盛首席經濟學家：通膨將溫和表現 就業已降溫 升息不必要
items.title_en: US July CPI to be Released Soon! Goldman Sachs Chief Economist: Inflation to Show a Mild Performance, Job Market Already Cooling, Rate Hike Not Necessary
paras: 美國 7 月消費者物價指數 (CPI) 將在台灣時間今 (12) 日晚上 8 點半出爐，這份數據被市場視為聯準會 (Fed) 下月利率決議的「分水嶺」，在 7 月非農就業數據意外減少 2.3 萬人差於預期後，通膨數據將決定 Fed 主席華許按兵不動還是重啟升息。
高盛首席經濟學家兼全球投資研究主管 Jan Hatzius 週二 (11 日) 受訪時預估，7 月 CPI 將僅月增 0.05%、核心 CPI 月增率約 0.19%，略低或持平於市場共識的 0.1%、核心 0.2%，年增率分別約 3.35% 與 2.47%，延續 6 月放緩趨勢，能源價格下跌為主因，租金與薪資通膨則持續自然降溫。
他將今年前 5 月通膨超預期歸因於三大臨時因素：關稅月度傳導、油價推升整體指數、世界盃相關服務漲價。
根據 Hatzius 估算，關稅同比效應仍為核心個人消費者支出 (PCE) 數據貢獻約 0.7 個百分點，核心 PCE 目前年率 3.3%，但月度傳導已基本結束，未來 6 至 12 個月該拖累趨向零。
就業方面，高盛把月度就業趨勢估計從 7.5 萬人大幅下修至約 5000 人，這一數字以三個月薪資與九個月家庭調查加權平均後，凸顯勞動市場在波動表象下快速降溫。
政策判讀上，Hatzius 明確表態高盛預測今年不用再升息，自然下行力量已使進一步緊縮不必要，即便華許暗示可能拓寬通膨視角、不全然綁定核心 PCE，Hatzius 仍預期核心 PCE 續居市場主要焦點至 2027 年以後，並贊同 2% 目標「是正確數字」。
美銀、滙豐亦押注數據走軟將壓低 Fed 下月升息機率。根據芝商所 (CME)FedWatch 數據，市場看好 9 月緊縮機率為五五開。
此外，Hatzius 對美國經濟給出「相當不錯」的評價，指出未來 1 至 2 年 GDP 將成長 2% 至 2.5%、失業率低且穩，但通膨仍是過去五年價格超漲的頑疾，通往更好通膨狀況的進程比預期更久。今晚 CPI 若如期溫和，將為 9 月暫停升息減壓，但若反彈超出預期，華許的「開放式框架」將面臨信任考驗。
paras_en: The US July Consumer Price Index (CPI) is set to be released at 8:30 PM Taiwan time on July 12. This data is seen as a "watershed" for the Federal Reserve (Fed) in making its interest rate decision next month. Following the unexpected decline of 230,000 jobs in the July non-farm employment data, the CPI data will determine whether Fed Chairman Jerome Powell will hold off on raising interest rates or restart the rate hike.

Goldman Sachs Chief Economist and Global Investment Research Head Jan Hatzius predicted in an interview on Tuesday (July 11) that the July CPI would only increase by 0.05% month-over-month, with core CPI increasing by approximately 0.19%. This is lower or in line with the market consensus of 0.1% and 0.2% respectively. The year-over-year rates are expected to be around 3.35% and 2.47%, continuing the trend of slowing down in June, mainly due to declining energy prices, with rent and wage inflation continuing to naturally cool down.

He attributed the inflation exceeding expectations in the first five months of this year to three temporary factors: the monthly transmission of tariffs, the increase in oil prices that pushed up the overall index, and the price increase related to the World Cup.

According to Hatzius' estimate, the tariff effect still contributes approximately 0.7 percentage points to the core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) data, with the core PCE currently at a year-over-year rate of 3.3%. However, the monthly transmission has basically ended, and in the future 6 to 12 months, this will drag down the trend to zero.

In terms of employment, Goldman Sachs has significantly revised its estimate of monthly employment trends from 75,000 to approximately 5,000. This number is based on the weighted average of three-month wages and nine-month household surveys, highlighting the rapid cooling of the labor market beneath the surface.

In terms of policy interpretation, Hatzius clearly stated that Goldman Sachs predicts that there will be no further rate hikes this year, as natural downward forces have made further tightening unnecessary. Even if Powell hinted at possibly expanding the inflation perspective and not fully binding to core PCE, Hatzius still expects core PCE to remain the main focus until 2027 and beyond, and agrees that the 2% target is the correct number.

Goldman Sachs, along with Morgan Stanley and HSBC, also bet on the data softening, which will put pressure on the Fed's decision to raise interest rates next month. According to the CME FedWatch data, the market expects a 50-50 chance of a rate hike in September.

In addition, Hatzius gave a 'quite good' assessment of the US economy, stating that GDP growth will be 2% to 2.5% over the next 1 to 2 years, with low and stable unemployment rates, but inflation remaining a stubborn problem. The progress towards better inflation will take longer than expected. Tonight's CPI, if it is as expected, will ease the pressure on the Fed to raise interest rates in September, but if it rebounds beyond expectations, Powell's 'open framework' will face a test of trust.

items.title: 輝達化解AI市場一大疑慮 分析師：可降低「循環交易」風險
items.title_en: Nvidia Resolves AI Market Concerns, Analysts Say
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，部分投資人一直擔心輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 與客戶之間緊密的財務關係，但分析師認為，輝達最新宣布的合作夥伴關係，應能暫時消除這些疑慮。
輝達日前宣布，已就「獨立運算融資」成立策略合作夥伴關係，規模超過 5,000 億美元，目的是長期支援人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設的發展。輝達表示，包括阿波羅全球管理 (Apollo Global Management)、黑石 (Blackstone) 及高盛 (Goldman Sachs) 在內的 6 家公司，將提供第三方資金。
摩根士丹利分析師 Joseph Moore 在給客戶的報告中表示，輝達主要利用第三方資金投資 AI 工廠，也就是大規模資料中心，「理應可以緩解市場對循環交易的疑慮」。
輝達執行長黃仁勳周一在 X 發文表示，公司可以視個案情況，為投資案提供最高 25% 的資金。
Moore 表示，在這樣的投資比例下，「具備專業能力的第三方投資團體」將掌握決策權，這應有助於消除市場對相關交易「純粹受到循環性動機驅動」的疑慮。
Moore 也認為，考量輝達在相關交易所處 AI 生態系統中扮演重要推動者的角色，這對輝達而言顯然具潛在正面效益。
輝達在新聞稿中表示，這些融資平台將使其晶片及其他 AI 產品「成為可投資的資產類別」，並創造「與長期使用量有關的營收」。Moore 表示，這意味著相關交易將納入輝達先前宣布的營收分成模式，讓公司「能夠從可能 100% 持續使用輝達產品的客戶身上推動營收成長」。
美國銀行分析師 Vivek Arya 也持相似看法，認為這些策略合作對輝達而言正面，因為「負擔由金融機構承擔」，而不是輝達的資產負債表。
Arya 指出，要讓運算能力被視為可投資資產，其「剩餘價值必須維持」，而輝達的晶片具備這項條件。他在報告中指出，輝達的 GPU 具可互換性，可被不同 AI 開發商使用，而其 CUDA 軟體則能延長晶片的使用壽命。因此，他認為輝達 GPU 的轉售及租賃價格仍可維持在高檔。
Arya 表示，「這個平台鞏固了 CUDA 護城河，同時將資本風險從輝達身上轉移出去。在我們看來，這是個結構性看多的布局。」但他也表示，新合作夥伴關係所促成的交易，仍需要來自真正客戶的實際資金。
Arya 認為，輝達本月底的財報電話會議，可能為華爾街及投資人提供「亟需的信心」，以了解公司未來在供應商融資中的角色。這類融資會侵蝕輝達的自由現金流。在他看來，這些資金「或許可以更有效的投入目前估值大幅偏低的股票」。
輝達股價周二小幅收低，至每股 217.50 美元。
摩根士丹利的 Moore 表示，輝達為新興雲端服務商及主權 AI 提供的後盾支持，他認為涉及信用風險，將成為「輝達股票下一個重大爭論點」。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that some investors have been concerned about Nvidia's (NVDA-US) close financial ties with its customers, but analysts believe that the company's latest announcement of a strategic partnership should alleviate these concerns.

Nvidia recently announced that it has established a strategic partnership for 'independent compute financing' with a scale of over $5 trillion, aiming to provide long-term support for the development of artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure.

Morgan Stanley analyst Joseph Moore stated in a report to clients that Nvidia mainly uses third-party funds to invest in AI factories, which are large-scale data centers, and 'should be able to alleviate market concerns about circular trading'.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said in a tweet on Monday that the company can provide up to 25% of the investment for each case.

Moore stated that with this investment ratio, 'professional third-party investment groups' will have decision-making power, which should help to eliminate market concerns that related transactions are driven solely by circular motives.
Moore also believes that considering Nvidia's role as a key driver in the AI ecosystem, this has obvious positive implications for the company.

Nvidia stated in a press release that these financing platforms will make its chips and other AI products 'investable asset classes' and create 'revenue related to long-term usage'. Moore stated that this means that related transactions will be included in Nvidia's previously announced revenue-sharing model, allowing the company to 'drive revenue growth from customers who may use Nvidia products continuously for 100%'.

US Bank analyst Vivek Arya also shares a similar view, believing that these strategic partnerships are positive for Nvidia because 'the burden is borne by financial institutions, not Nvidia's balance sheet'.

Arya pointed out that for computational power to be viewed as an investable asset, 'its residual value must be maintained', and Nvidia's chips meet this condition. He stated in the report that Nvidia's GPUs have interchangeability, can be used by different AI developers, and its CUDA software can extend the lifespan of the chips. Therefore, he believes that Nvidia's GPU resale and rental prices can still maintain a high level.

Arya stated, 'This platform solidifies the CUDA moat, and transfers capital risk from Nvidia. In our view, this is a structural bull case.' However, he also stated that the transactions promoted by the new partnership relationship still require actual capital from real customers.

Arya believes that Nvidia's earnings call on the last day of the month may provide 'much-needed confidence' for Wall Street and investors to understand the company's future role in supplier financing. This type of financing will erode Nvidia's free cash flow. In his view, these funds 'may be invested more effectively in stocks that are currently significantly undervalued'.
Nvidia's stock price fell slightly on Tuesday to $217.50 per share.
Morgan Stanley's Moore stated that Nvidia's support for emerging cloud service providers and sovereign AI will be 'the next major controversy point for Nvidia stock'.

items.title: 晶片股跌、它反而漲 量化資金推動「完美對沖」浮現
items.title_en: Chip Stocks Fall, Yet They Rise: Quant Funds Drive a "Perfect Hedge" Emerging
paras: AI熱潮席捲美股之際，一場反向資金輪動正悄然成形。FactSet數據顯示，近幾個月半導體與醫療保健股逐漸轉為負相關，晶片股遭遇賣壓時，資金反而湧向醫療股。隨著量化基金加速在科技與防禦型類股間換倉，醫療保健股正浮現為晶片股的「完美對沖」。
多年來，美股醫療保健與半導體類股之間的關聯並不明顯，即使偶爾同向波動，關係也相當鬆散。
然而，這項規律近幾個月明顯改變，VanEck半導體ETF(SMH-US) 與SPDR 健康護理指數 ETF(XLV-US) 開始呈現負相關，也就是晶片股下跌時，醫療保健股往往獲得資金青睞。
高盛美國醫療保健股票研究主管Asad Haider指出，如今左右醫療保健類股交易邏輯的最大焦點，其實來自產業之外，這種情況對專注公司基本面的投資人而言相當棘手。
背後推手之一正是量化資金。演算法會持續監測市場訊號，一旦動能指標轉向，量化基金可能迅速撤離科技股等交易過度擁擠的領域，轉進先前遭市場冷落的醫療保健股。近期換倉速度加劇，也反映投資人對AI熱潮能否持續的戒心正在升高。
醫療股成晶片股「完美對沖」
這種資金輪動在近期行情尤其明顯。6月下旬至7月下旬市場劇烈震盪期間，隨著投資人對AI多頭行情能否延續的疑慮升高，醫療保健類股漲幅一度跑贏半導體超過30個百分點。
這與過去四年的情況形成強烈反差。這段期間，SMH累計漲幅曾超過300%，XLV則僅上漲約25%。如今兩者表現迅速拉開，也凸顯市場開始將醫療保健股視為對沖晶片股風險的工具。
估值差距同樣提供支撐。約十年前，在AI概念尚未爆發時，晶片與醫療保健類股的遠期本益比都約在15至16倍；如今FactSet數據顯示，SMH近幾個月遠期本益比維持在22至30倍高檔，XLV則約為18倍。
AI需求確實讓半導體產業擁有更快的成長速度，但市場目前最大的疑問也正是，這樣的高成長究竟還能維持多久。
防禦屬性撐起避險價值
醫療保健股之所以能扮演避險角色，關鍵在於產業屬性與半導體截然不同。半導體具有高度週期性，醫療保健則具備非週期性的防禦特徵。
不論總體經濟如何變化，或AI基礎建設進展如何，患者對藥物與醫療服務仍存在剛性需求，因此相關企業的業績與現金流在經濟放緩期間通常相對穩定。
此外，醫療產業先前面臨的政治壓力也逐漸降溫。市場對川普政府大幅削減藥價的疑慮下降，美國聯邦Medicare健保計畫公布的支付標準也高於原先預期；禮來(LLY-US) 、嬌生(JNJ-US) 、聯合健康集團(UNH-US) 與艾伯維(ABBV-US) 等大型企業，則持續展現相對穩健且可預測的獲利成長。
AI行情決定對沖交易能走多遠
展望後市，醫療保健類股未來一、兩年的實際表現，很大程度仍取決於AI交易熱潮將走到哪個階段。
2022年美股熊市便提供類似案例，當時通膨高漲、聯準會激進升息，高估值科技股重挫，醫療保健類股期間跑贏半導體超過30個百分點。
不過，資金以宏觀邏輯買進整個醫療保健產業，也可能掩蓋個別企業基本面的差異。
百時美施貴寶與強生過去12個月股價都上漲逾40%，但兩者基本面並不相同：強生維持穩定獲利成長，百時美施貴寶則面臨核心專利到期帶來的業績下滑壓力。
Haider因此強調，無論AI交易接下來如何發展，較穩健的策略仍是聚焦能夠實現營收內生成長的企業，而非單純買進看似便宜的股票。
隨著醫療保健產業基本面逐步企穩，本身的防禦與成長特性已提供配置理由；若AI主線交易進一步瓦解，其作為晶片股對沖工具的吸引力，可能更加凸顯。
paras_en: As the AI frenzy sweeps U.S. equities, a reverse capital rotation is quietly taking shape. FactSet data shows that in recent months semiconductor and healthcare stocks have become increasingly negatively correlated; when chip stocks face selling pressure, capital instead flows into healthcare stocks. As quantitative funds accelerate the reallocation between technology and defensive sectors, healthcare stocks are emerging as the "perfect hedge" for chip stocks.
For many years, the relationship between U.S. healthcare and semiconductor stocks has been unclear, and even when they moved in the same direction, the link was quite loose.

However, this pattern has changed markedly in recent months, with the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH-US) and the SPDR Health Care Sector ETF (XLV-US) beginning to show a negative correlation—meaning that when chip stocks fall, healthcare stocks often attract capital.

Asad Haider, head of U.S. healthcare equity research at Goldman Sachs, noted that the biggest driver of current trading logic for healthcare stocks actually comes from outside the industry, a situation that is especially tricky for investors focused on company fundamentals.

One of the forces behind this is quantitative capital. Algorithms continuously monitor market signals, and once momentum indicators reverse, quantitative funds may quickly exit crowded areas such as tech stocks and move into healthcare stocks that have been neglected by the market. The recent acceleration in reallocation also reflects growing investor caution about whether the AI boom can be sustained.
Healthcare stocks as the "perfect hedge" for chip stocks

This capital rotation has been especially evident in recent market action. During the volatile period from late June to late July, as investors grew more doubtful about the continuation of the AI bull market, healthcare stocks surged, at times outperforming semiconductors by more than 30 percentage points.

That contrasts sharply with the past four years. In that period, SMH posted a cumulative gain of over 300%, while XLV rose only about 25%. The widening gap now highlights the market’s shift toward viewing healthcare stocks as a tool to hedge chip‑stock risk.

Valuation differences also provide support. About a decade ago, before the AI concept exploded, forward price‑to‑earnings ratios for both chips and healthcare were roughly 15‑16 times; today FactSet data shows SMH’s forward P/E has been stuck in the high 22‑30 range, while XLV’s is around 18 times.
AI demand indeed gives the semiconductor industry a faster growth trajectory, but the market’s biggest question now is how long such high growth can be maintained.
Defensive attributes underpin hedging value

Healthcare stocks can play a defensive role because the sector’s fundamentals are fundamentally different from semiconductors. Semiconductors are highly cyclical, whereas healthcare has non‑cyclical, defensive characteristics.

Regardless of macro‑economic shifts or the progress of AI infrastructure, patients continue to have rigid demand for drugs and medical services, so the earnings and cash flow of related companies tend to remain relatively stable during economic slowdowns.

In addition, the political pressures that previously weighed on the healthcare industry are easing. Concerns about the Trump administration’s large drug‑price cuts have receded, and the U.S. Medicare payment standards have been announced higher than expected. Large firms such as Eli Lilly (LLY-US), Johnson & Johnson (JNJ-US), UnitedHealth Group (UNH-US) and AbbVie (ABBV-US) continue to show relatively steady and predictable profit growth.
How far hedging trades can go depends on the AI market
Looking ahead, the actual performance of healthcare stocks over the next one to two years will largely depend on which stage the AI trading boom reaches.

The 2022 U.S. bear market provides a similar case: high inflation and aggressive Fed rate hikes caused heavily‑valued tech stocks to plunge, while healthcare stocks outperformed semiconductors by more than 30 percentage points during that period.
However, buying the entire healthcare sector on a macro basis can also mask differences in individual company fundamentals.

Both Bristol‑Myers Squibb and Johnson & Johnson have seen their shares rise over 40% in the past 12 months, but their fundamentals differ: Johnson & Johnson maintains stable earnings growth, whereas Bristol‑Myers faces earnings pressure from core patent expirations.

Haider therefore emphasizes that, regardless of how AI trading evolves, a more prudent strategy remains to focus on companies that can generate internal revenue growth rather than simply buying stocks that appear cheap.

As the healthcare industry’s fundamentals gradually stabilize, its defensive and growth traits already provide a rationale for allocation; if the AI trade further unravels, its appeal as a hedge for chip stocks could become even more pronounced.

items.title: 川普政府：TikTok業務重組後不再被視為國安威脅 已正式解禁
items.title_en: Trump Administration: TikTok No Longer Deemed a National Security Threat After Business Restructuring, Officially Unbanned
paras: 根據白宮管理和預算辦公室(OMB)本周發布的最新備忘錄，美國政府已正式撤銷2023年制定的聯邦設備TikTok禁令。這項重大轉變源於美國司法部上個月的一項法律意見，認為在完成業務重組後，TikTok已不再符合2022年法律所定義的「受管制應用程式」。
此次解禁的核心在於TikTok美國業務的深度重組。今年1月，TikTok USDS合資公司正式運作，股權結構發生劇烈變動：甲骨文(ORCL-US)、銀湖資本(Silver Lake)及阿聯MGX各持股15%，母公司字節跳動的持股比例降至19.9%，新公司的董事會成員多數為美國人。
在技術層面上，TikTok為消除國安疑慮，已將美國用戶數據全數遷往甲骨文的美國本地伺服器，並針對美國用戶重新訓練推薦算法。
司法部指出，目前的TikTok運作獨立於字節跳動，並已修訂其內容推薦機制與網路安全程序，足以隔絕聯邦政府資訊遭竊取的風險。
川普對TikTok的態度轉變也備受矚目。2020年曾強硬要求禁用的他，在2024年競選期間卻頻繁利用該平台與選民互動，並將勝選部分歸功於此。川普不僅稱讚TikTok，還對中國領導人習近平協助推動出售交易表達謝意。
TikTok在美國擁有超過2億用戶，已成為政治人物接觸年輕選民的核心陣地。雖然聯邦禁令已撤銷，但司法部強調各部門仍有裁量權，並非強制要求所有聯邦設備安裝
paras_en: According to a new memorandum released this week by the White House Office of Management and Budget (OMB), the U.S. government has formally lifted the federal‑device TikTok ban that was enacted in 2023. The shift follows a legal opinion from the Department of Justice last month that concluded TikTok no longer meets the definition of a “controlled application” under the 2022 law after completing its business restructuring.

The core of the unbanning is the deep restructuring of TikTok’s U.S. operations. In January, the TikTok USDS joint venture began operating, and its ownership structure changed dramatically: Oracle (ORCL‑US), Silver Lake and UAE‑based MGX each hold 15%, while the parent company ByteDance’s stake fell to 19.9%. Most members of the new company’s board are Americans.
On the technical side, TikTok has moved all U.S. user data to Oracle’s U.S.‑based servers and has retrained its recommendation algorithm for U.S. users to eliminate national‑security concerns.

The Justice Department notes that TikTok now operates independently of ByteDance and has revised its content recommendation mechanisms and cybersecurity procedures enough to isolate the risk of federal government information being stolen.

Trump’s attitude toward TikTok has also shifted dramatically. After forcefully demanding a ban in 2020, he frequently used the platform to interact with voters during his 2024 campaign and credited part of his victory to it. Trump not only praised TikTok but also thanked Chinese leader Xi Jinping for helping facilitate the sale transaction.

TikTok has over 200 million users in the United States and has become a key arena for politicians to reach young voters. Although the federal ban has been lifted, the Justice Department emphasizes that individual agencies still retain discretion and are not required to install the app on all federal devices.

items.title: CoCo壹番屋成經濟指標！美策略師創「咖哩豬排指數」：日元遭嚴重低估 兌美元公允價應為62.18
items.title_en: Coco Ichibanya Becomes Economic Indicator! US Strategist Creates 'Curry Pork Cutlet Index': Yen Severely Undervalued, Fair Value Against Dollar Should Be 62.18
paras: 紐約梅隆銀行高級策略師 Geoff Yu 以日式「咖哩豬排飯」為基準創建「咖哩豬排指數」，試圖更精準捕捉日元貶值對日本民眾的實際痛感。
相較於漢堡，咖哩飯作為日本國民主食，更能反映日常物價與購買力的真實變化，因此「咖哩豬排指數」被視為《經濟學人》「大麥克指數」的本土化替代指標，
日元兌美元匯率在今 (12) 日亞洲早盤交易時段徘徊在 159.23 的數十年低點附近，意味著在市場定價下，1 美元可兌換近 159 日元，但 Yu 以全球最大咖哩連鎖 CoCo 壹番屋的跨國售價計算，考量日元在日本國內的實際購買力後，1 美元公允價值僅應兌換 62.18 日元。這一數據顯示，當前匯市對日元低估程度遠超過大麥克指數所暗示的 80.3 日元。
Yu 指出，若政策目標是將日本購買力對齊其他高收入國家，日元匯價遠未達到合理水平。
「咖哩豬排指數」凸顯出日本官方干預匯市與實體經濟感受之間的落差。
儘管東京當局近期出手支撐日元，但在連鎖餐飲價格的鏡像下，日元在日本國內的實質價值被嚴重低估，民眾生活成本壓力遠高於匯率數字呈現的表象。
paras_en: New York Mellon Bank senior strategist Geoff Yu created the 'Curry Pork Cutlet Index' based on Japanese-style curry rice, trying to more accurately capture the actual pain felt by Japanese citizens from yen depreciation.

Compared to burgers, curry rice is Japan's national staple food, and it can better reflect the real changes in daily prices and purchasing power, so the 'Curry Pork Cutlet Index' is seen as a domesticized alternative to the Economist's Big Mac Index.

The yen's exchange rate against the US dollar hovered around a 159.23 level in the Asian early trading session on the 12th, indicating that 1 US dollar can be exchanged for nearly 159 yen in market pricing, but Yu calculated the fair value of 1 US dollar to be only 62.18 yen based on the global largest curry chain CoCo Ichibanya's cross-border sales prices, considering the actual purchasing power of the yen in Japan.
Yu pointed out that if the policy goal is to align Japan's purchasing power with other high-income countries, the yen's exchange rate is far from reaching a reasonable level.
The 'Curry Pork Cutlet Index' highlights the gap between the Japanese government's intervention in the foreign exchange market and the actual feelings of the economy.

Although the Tokyo authorities have recently stepped in to support the yen, the yen's actual value in Japan is severely undervalued in the mirror of chain restaurant prices, and the pressure on people's living costs is far higher than the appearance presented by the exchange rate numbers.

items.title: 挪威主權基金上半年狂賺1820億美元！報酬率達9.4% 首度曝光SpaceX持股
items.title_en: Norway Sovereign Fund Earns $182 Billion in First Half, Returns 9.4% as First Reveals Stake in SpaceX
paras: 全球最大、挪威規模2.3兆美元的主權財富基金周三(12日)公布，在科技股帶動下，上半年獲利超過1820億美元，創歷年同期新高，報酬率達9.4%。
該基金公布上半年績效之際，也首度揭露持有馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US)約0.05%股權，價值逾12億美元。
目前挪威主權財富基金持有的SpaceX，規模仍遠低於其他主要持股。截至6月30日，該基金持有輝達(NVDA-US)1.3%股權，價值618億美元，另持有蘋果(AAPL-US)1.2%股權，價值527億美元。
挪威主權財富基金成立於1990年代，主要投資挪威石油與天然氣產業所創造的收入，由挪威央行投資管理公司(Norges Bank Investment Management, NBIM)負責管理。目前基金規模約2.34兆美元，投資遍及50多個國家的7000多家公司，持有全球上市股票約1.5%的股權。
NBIM執行長Nicolai Tangen周三說：「這項績效主要受到股市良好報酬帶動，尤其是亞洲科技股表現突出。」
該基金投資組合中，股票占超過三分之二，其餘投資標的包括固定收益、房地產及再生能源基礎建設。
NBIM投資組合約40%配置於美股，市值最大的持股為輝達、蘋果及微軟(MSFT-US)。
paras_en: The world's largest sovereign wealth fund, with a scale of $2.3 trillion from Norway, announced on Wednesday (12th) that it made a profit of over $182 billion in the first half of the year, a new high for the same period, with a return of 9.4%.
The fund also revealed for the first time that it holds a stake of approximately 0.05% in SpaceX (SPCX-US), valued at over $1.2 billion.

The Norwegian sovereign wealth fund's holding in SpaceX is still far lower than its major holdings. As of June 30, the fund held a 1.3% stake in NVIDIA (NVDA-US), valued at $6.18 billion, and a 1.2% stake in Apple (AAPL-US), valued at $5.27 billion.
